entries.en: He is a former graduate of the Adventure Seminar so to speak. He has a distrust of a fellow lecturer Mito and every day he is torn between fear and fear that he will be cheated and stripped to the ground at any moment. He likes the nicknames he's been given.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ゼミ講師の『アジタリオ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 成長したカオス・スピリットが合体して半獣半蛇の魔物となった。製造プラントとしての役割を持ち、各部の球体は熟すと地面に落ちて無数のカオス・シードを生成する。嫌いなものはユニコーン。
entries.en: The chaos spirit that had grown up merged into a half-beast half-snake demon. Serving as a production base the spheres in each part fall to the ground as they ripen producing countless chaos seeds. What they hate are unicorns.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カオス・サーペント
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 邪悪な神が、封印される間際に世界中にばら撒いた悪意の種。人間をマナごと取り込んで人型に成長していく。根絶やしにしようと神々が頑張っているが、潜伏するうえに増殖力が高いのでなかなか数が減らない。
entries.en: The seeds of malice that an evil god scattered throughout the world on the verge of being sealed. It takes in humans with mana and grows into a humanoid. The gods are working hard to eradicate them but their numbers don't decrease easily because they have a high ability to multiply in addition to hiding.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カオス・シード
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 世界一のプラチナ鉱山の持ち主。自分の鉱山から出たものが原型をとどめないほどに加工され、よく知らない人たちの手に渡り、使われるということに興奮する変人。自宅に趣味で大量のガチョウを飼っている。
entries.en: The owner of the world's largest platinum mine. An eccentric who gets excited about the fact that something from his own mine has been processed to such an extent that it no longer resembles its original form and is now in the hands of people he doesn't know well. He keeps a large number of geese at home as a hobby.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 有閑鉱山王『ジシリオン』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 多くの死者を出した戦場などに生えた木が、死者の肉体、マナ、魂を余すところなく吸収した結果、強大な妖異と化した。怨念の集合体にして呪われた存在。
entries.en: The trees that grew on the battlefields where many died absorbing the bodies mana and souls of the dead in their entirety became powerful demons. A cursed being made into a collection of grudges.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 呪木王
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ドラゴンの格好よさに憧れた霊樹が、長年かけて自らの身体を変化させたもの。体表の緑色のコケに魔力を蓄えており、飛行も可能。長時間飛行する際は根の部分で土を掴んで持っていく。
entries.en: Having who longed for the good looks of a dragon it transformed its own body over the years. The green moss on its body surface stores magical power and it can also fly. When flying for long periods of time it holds on to soil by the roots and carries it along.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 深緑竜樹
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 争いの果てに木に変えられてしまった女神が、気の遠くなるほどの年月を経てどうにかほぼ人型にまで戻ってきた姿。もはや信仰心を集めるほどの力はなく、光合成しながら世間に八つ当たりする毎日。
entries.en: A goddess who was transformed into a tree after a conflict but somehow managed to return to almost humanoid form after an unbearable number of years. She is no longer powerful enough to gather religious beliefs and every day she takes it out on the world while photosynthesizing.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 荒神樹
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ハンノキの王。性格は邪悪そのものであり、人間を惑わして破滅へと導く。具体的には、馬で運ばれている最中の病気の子供に魔王として語りかけ、恐ろしい幻影を見せてショック死させるとか。
entries.en: King of the ents. His personality is evil itself and he misleads and guides humans to their destruction. Specifically he talks to a sick child who is being carried on a horse as a demon king and gives him a terrifying vision and shocks him to death.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アールキング
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: うねった複数の幹を持つ。幹を伸ばして歩き、その進路上にいるものを生きたまま取り込んで成長する。別名絞め殺しの木。幹がうねっているのは、取り込まれたものが最期に暴れるからだという。
entries.en: It has multiple trunks that are undulating. It walks with an outstretched trunk and grows by taking in the living in its path. Also known as the tree of strangulation. It is said that the reason the trunk is undulating is because the thing that has been taken in is violently struggling until the very end.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ガジュマルの怪
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人間に擬態した妖木。長髪で誤魔化しているが、化け切れておらず背中が完全に木。抱き寄せた時に背中が尋常じゃなくごつごつしていたり、木の枝が背中からはみ出している自称森ガールがいたら大体こいつ。
entries.en: A tree mimicking a human. Don't be misguided by her long hair she is not disfigured but her back is completely wooden. If there's a self-proclaimed forest girl whose back is unusually rough and branches are protruding from her back when she hugs you she' s usually this thing.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: スクーグスロー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 戦争に巻き込まれて妻を失ったため、戦争を根絶する手段を求め故郷を出奔。娘を連れて各地を放浪している最中、ヴァリウスと出会いその思想に共感した。娘と歩いていて兄妹に間違えられるのがちょっと嬉しい。
entries.en: After losing his wife in the war he fled his hometown in search of a way to end the conflict. While wandering around the country with his daughter he met Vallius and sympathized with his ideas. I'm a little glad I'm walking with my daughter and being mistaken for a brother.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ロスリアの蒼風『アルフレド』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 機械文明の最終戦争で使われた戦車。猫を思わせる程に運動性が高く、戦闘機や人型兵器を震え上がらせた。後継機は更なる超運動性を目指したが、敵への印象操作のためあえてマンモスと名付けられた。
entries.en: A tank used in the final war of a mechanical civilization. It was so agile that it reminded me of a cat and it made fighters and humanoid weapons tremble. Its successor aimed to be even more mobile but was purposely named Mammoth in order to fool the enemy.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ケーニヒスカッツェ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 当初はペットロボットとして造られたが、やがて大型化され戦闘機獣として用いられるようになった。他の星から輸入された機械犬とこの星の機械犬の雑種がルーツ。激しく動くので性能を引き出すのは大変。
entries.en: Initially built as a pet robot it was eventually enlarged to be used as a fighter beast. Rooted in machine dogs imported from other planets and a hybrid of machine dogs from this planet. It's hard to get the best performance out of it because it moves so violently.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ゾイボ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: パワー・スピード・テクニックに優れ、自律行動で破壊と創造を繰り返す古代のモンスターマシン。当時の戦闘車両を真っ向から撃破したという記録も残っている。環境適応機能を持ち、劣悪な現場でもへっちゃら。
entries.en: An ancient monster machine with superior power speed and technique it acts autonomously to destroy and reproduce repeatedly. It is also recorded that it defeated the fighting vehicles of the time head-on. It has an environment-adaptive function and can be used even in poor conditions.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 超重機ビルディオン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 機械文明中期の量産型歩行マシン。頭部に人が乗り込める。機械信仰の素晴らしさを広めるプロパガンダに使われていたが、地味に軍用機並の頑丈さとアームの強さを誇る。
entries.en: A mass-produced walking machine in the heights of a mechanical civilization. A person can get in the head. It was used for propaganda to spread the splendor of the machine but it also boasted the sturdiness and limb strength of a military-grade aircraft.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ライドクレリック
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 機械文明初期に使われていた主力兵器。装甲は薄いが軽量で小回りが利き、悪路にも強い。他の戦闘兵器が発達した後でも、かなりの数が自律回路を更新して長く運用されていたらしい。
entries.en: The main weapon used in the early days of mechanical civilization. Due to its thin armor it is lightweight and can be used for small turns and is reliable on rough roads. Apparently quite a few had been operating long after other combat weapons had been developed with updated autonomous circuits.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ゼイレン自動軽戦車
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カブの仲間だが、大型でかなりの速度を出せる。カブと比べると寿命が短く、気難しくて荒っぽい。比較的手がかかるが、カブに慣れていてスピードを求めているのなら飼ってみてもいいだろう。
entries.en: It's a member of the cubs but it's large and capable of considerable speed. It has a shorter lifespan than a cub and is grumpy and rough. It's a relative pain in the ass but if you're used to cubs and are looking for speed it's a good idea to keep one.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 大型バイク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 良くも悪くもまっすぐなエレアの青年。正義感の強かった亡き父に憧れ、森の自警団に所属していた。かつて各国の軍が森へ侵攻してきた際には、即席の妨害部隊を結成し最後まで地味に抵抗を続けていたらしい。
entries.en: For better or worse this young man is a straightforward Elean. Admiring his late father who had a strong sense of justice he was a member of the forest vigilante group. In the past when armies from various countries invaded the forest they formed an impromptu interdiction squad and steadfastly resisted until the end.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 過激派の『ハリオン』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた最上級アンデッド兵器。現存しないものと思われていたが、最近エウダーナの古代遺跡から他の兵器を伴い現れた。ある女性が制御に成功するまで破壊の限りを尽くしたという。
entries.en: A superlative undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. It was thought to be extinct but it recently emerged from the ancient ruins of Eulderna accompanied by other weapons. It is said that one woman went to great lengths to destroy it until she managed to get it under control.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ユナイデッド・キング
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。単純戦闘力を重視したキングタイプと違い、後方支援を重視して造られた。知能がなかなか高く、サヴァントクイーンをライバル視して張り合う。
entries.en: An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. Unlike the King type which emphasized simple combat power the Queen type was built with an emphasis on logistical support. Her intelligence is quite high and she rivals the Savant Queen.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ユナイデッド・クイーン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた上級アンデッド兵器。人骨部分は近接武装をしているが、竜骨の背中にくっついている関係上格闘戦は苦手。どちらかというと制御ユニットとしての役割が大きいらしい。
entries.en: An advanced undead weapon used by the biochemical civilization. The skeleton is armed with melee weapons but it is not good at fighting because it is attached to the back of a dragon skeleton. If anything it seems to play a larger role as a control unit.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ユナイデッド・ジャック
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 生化学文明期に使われていた特殊アンデッド兵器。半霊体を無理やり屍人形に憑依させたもの。気味の悪い声で笑いながら戦場を滅茶苦茶にひっかき回す道化。
entries.en: A special undead weapon that was used during the biochemical civilization. A half-spirit body is forcibly possessed by a corpse doll. A clown who scrambles around the battlefield laughing in a creepy voice.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ユナイデッド・ジョーカー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イークの割には強い力と立派な勇気を持ち、イークの中でも英雄とされている者たち。集落を襲った猪を倒したり、腕試しに来た騎士と真っ向から戦ったりする。
entries.en: They are considered heroes among the yeeks having strong power and admirable courage for a yeek. He defeats a boar that has attacked his village or fights head-on with a knight who has come to test his skills.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヒロイーク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 事故で人間並みの知性を手に入れたが、代償に理性が欠如したイーク。それゆえに悪魔や邪神の強大さに簡単に魅入られてしまった。他のイークたちからは、近寄るとヤバイやつだと認識されている。
entries.en: In an accident he gains human-level intelligence but at the cost of his mind losing his reason. That's why he was so easily enchanted by the mighty power of demons and evil gods. The other yeeks recognize him as a dangerous individual if he gets close to them.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ルナテイーク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イークの古代種。種類関係なくイーク族を使役する能力を持つ。イークのイークによるイークのための国家を創る、という大層な野望を持っているが、具体的にどうすればいいのかまでは考えていない。
entries.en: An ancient species of yeeks. It has the ability to employ yeek tribes regardless of type. He has grand ambitions to create a nation of yeeks by yeeks for yeeks but he doesn't even think about how to go about it concretely.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マスター・アルカイーク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イークの古代種。拳銃が大好きであり、よくノリノリで人間のガンマンの真似をしている。拳銃は拾いもの。自分たちで作るほどの技術は持っていない。
entries.en: An ancient species of yeek. He loves guns and often imitates a human gunman. A handgun is scavenged. They don't have the skills to make it themselves.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アルカイークの銃士
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イークの古代種。体が頑丈で力も強いが、他の生物に比べるとやはり劣る。そのためか現代では繁殖力が高く小型の種類のイークが台頭している。あまり群れようとしないが仲間意識は強い。
entries.en: An ancient species of yeek. Their bodies are strong and sturdy but they are not as strong as other creatures. Perhaps because of this small highly fertile species of yeek have emerged in modern times. They don't try to flock but they have a strong sense of camaraderie.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アルカイーク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 昔は酷いなまけものだった。しかし命がけでネフィアをひとつ攻略してから心機一転。冒険の楽しさに目覚め、今日も遺跡荒らしとして働いている。
entries.en: He used to be a terrible slob. However after risking his life to conquer one of the Nefian dungeons he had a change of heart. He has awakened to the joy of adventure and is still working as a ruins vandal today.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イークの働き者
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 実家に縛られるのを嫌い幼い頃に家出。放浪中に誤って裏の業界へ踏み入ってしまうが、記憶力と洞察力で賭博に逆転勝利し生き残った。その後スリルを求めて裏の仕事に携わる中、一人の行き倒れに出会う。
entries.en: She ran away from home at an early age because she hated being tied to her parents' home. While wandering she accidentally ventured into the underworld but survived by winning the gamble to regain her memory and insight. Later while working behind the scenes in search of thrills he meets a man who has fallen.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 妄想少女『リアナ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 別名、クイックリングの仕事人。小さい体を活かして闇に紛れ、標的を待ち伏せする。そして糸を自在に操って目にもとまらぬ速さで標的を惨殺するのだ。その腕前は鮮やか。
entries.en: Also known as a quickling workman. He uses his small body to blend in with the darkness and ambush his targets. He then manipulates the string to slaughter the target with uncanny speed. His skills are superb.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヘルストリング
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 冥界の僻地に吹きすさぶという、瘴気の嵐の中で生まれる特殊なクイックリング。風の噂でストームブリンガーとかいう黒い剣があると聞いてから、運命めいたものを感じている。
entries.en: This special quickling is created by a storm of miasma that blew into a remote area of the underworld. They've felt a sense of destiny after hearing that there was a black sword called Stormbringer from rumors in the wind.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ストームブリング
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 草原を駆ける小人。尋常でない脚力を持ち、足を一振りするだけで衝撃波が発生する。代償として生まれつき膝に爆弾を抱えており、全力で走ったり蹴ったりすると反動に耐え切れずに破裂してしまう難儀な生物。
entries.en: A midget running through a meadow. It has extraordinary leg strength and a shockwave is generated with a single swing of the leg. As a quid pro quo it was born with a charge in its knee and if it runs or kicks with all its might it will be unable to withstand the recoil and explode.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: グラスキラー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クイックリングの近縁種。草原で踊り狂う小人。手先が器用で陽気な性格。普段はステップが速すぎてどんな踊りなのかよくわからないが、時折見せる魅力的な動作と妖しい視線は、観客の心を一瞬で惑わす。
entries.en: A close relative of Quickling. A midget dancing in the meadow. He has a dexterous hand and a cheerful personality. Usually the steps are too fast to know what kind of dance they are doing but sometimes their charming movements and mysterious gazes will bewitch the audience in an instant.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: グラスダンサー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ザナンの秘密実験施設で酷使されていた兵士。脱出・亡命できたのはいいが身体の異状に悩まされていた。ロスリアで最近開発された緩和薬によって、能力はやや落ちるものの安定性を手に入れた模様。
entries.en: A soldier who has been subjected to harsh treatment at a secret experimental facility in Zanan. He was able to flee and defect but he was suffering from a physical disorder. With the recent development of a palliative in Lothria he seems to have gained stability although his abilities are slightly less.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ザナン強化兵
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 熟練した兵士だったが寄る年波には勝てないと判断され、とっくの昔に軍を強制引退させられている。血で汚れすぎた自分は戦場でしか生きられないと悟り、他国へ亡命。経験を買われ再就職できた。
entries.en: He was a skilled soldier but he was forced out of the army long ago when it was decided that he was no match given to his age. He realizes that he has become too stained with blood and can only live on the battlefield so he goes into exile in another country. He was able to re-enter the workforce because of his experience.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 歴戦の老兵
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 看護疲れをこじらせ、殺人の快楽に目覚めたナース。機関銃を乱射して連続殺人を繰り返す。殺した後に慈愛の心が一瞬だけ蘇り、死体に優しく接する。
entries.en: The nurses tire of nursing and awaken to the pleasures of murder. They fire a machine gun and go on a series of murders. Their compassionate hearts revived for a moment after the killing and they treat the corpse gently.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キラーナース
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 前ロスリア騎士団長の実娘。父に戦いから遠ざけられていたが、本人の強い希望で衛生兵に。父が任務で出払っている間に高い戦闘才能が開花し、団長代理にまでに登りつめた。親譲りのクセ毛が悩み。
entries.en: Daughter of the former Commander of the Knights of Lothria. Although her father kept her from fighting she became a corpsman at her own insistence. While her father was away on a mission her high fighting talent blossomed and she rose to the rank of Acting Commander. The spiky hair that is inherited from her parents bothers her.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蒼天の稲妻『ランカータ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヴァリウスが失脚した際に解体された、ロスリア騎士団が母体。ヴァリウスの復権に伴って密かに再招集され、影で様々な任務を遂行していた。エウダーナから流入した魔鎧を改良した物を着用している。
entries.en: The parent company is the Knights of Lothria which was disbanded when Vallius was deposed. He was secretly recalled with the return of Vallius and carried out various missions in the shadows. He wears a modified version of the magical armor that came in from Eulderna.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ロスリア特務部隊
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 普通のエレアとは同じルーツを持つが、異形の森の外での暮らしに適応した亜種。強い魔力と褐色の肌を持ち、群れを作りたがらないのが特徴。性格面では普通のエレアに比べて好戦的で世俗的。
entries.en: A subspecies that has the same roots as a normal Elea but has adapted to life outside the strange forest. They have strong magical powers dark skin and are reluctant to form groups. In terms of personality they are more warlike and worldly than normal Elea.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ダークエレア
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キッカス-ニーサの国境付近で商売をしていた丘の民。冒険商人を自称しており、戦場などの危険な場所で商品を売りさばく。需要のある場所で物を高く売るのがスタイルらしく、扱う商品を場所によって変える。
entries.en: Hillfolk who traded near the border of Kikkas. A self-proclaimed adventurer she sells her wares on the battlefield and in other dangerous places. It seems that her style is to sell things at high prices where there is a high demand so she changes the products she deals with from place to place.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 冒険商人『メニティア』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ブラックホールに生息していた宇宙蟹。異星種に捕獲され、侵略用に品種改良された。主にハサミと溶解液で戦う。可愛らしい鳴き声と動きから、近年では宇宙ペットとして飼われているケースもある。
entries.en: A space crab that inhabited a black hole. It was captured by an alien species and bred for use in invasions. Mainly fighting with scissors and liquid solvents. In recent years some of them have been kept as space pets because of their adorable calls and movements.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 暗黒宇宙蟹
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 異形の森に住んでいた巨大ダンゴムシ。人間以上の知性と寛大な心を持ち、森の王者として君臨。エレアとも共生しており、森が焼かれた際には炎に囲まれた人々を身を挺して導いた。正体は生化学文明の遺産。
entries.en: A giant sowbug that lived in a bizarre forest. He reigns as the king of the forest with an intelligence beyond that of humans and a generous heart. He also lives in symbiosis with Elea and when the forest was burned he led the people amidst the flames with his strength. In reality he is a relic of a biochemical civilization.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 甲殻王者『キングダンゴムシ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 冥界蟹の近縁種。三途の川の河川敷から、冥海の海岸まで幅広く分布しており、あちら側では冥界蟹よりもポピュラーな存在。発達した片腕で死者を導く習性があるが、生者は魂ごと引っ張られるので危険。
entries.en: A close relative of the underworld crab. It is widely found from the riverbed of the Sanzu River to the shore of the Underworld and is more popular than the Underworld crab on the other side. It has a habit of guiding the dead with one arm but it is dangerous to the living because their souls will be pulled away.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 死ヲ招キ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 重なり合った王冠のような形の外殻を持つ。その見た目から古代サイロニアでは王の資質を見定める存在とされ、背中に登るのが王位継承の儀式となっていた。現代でも祭りにその儀式の名残が見られる。
entries.en: It has an outer shell that is shaped like an overlapping crown. Because of its appearance it was regarded as the judge of kingly qualities in ancient Cyronia and climbing on its back was a ritual of succession to the throne. Remnants of the ritual can still be seen in festivals today.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 王冠蟲
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 超古代に絶滅したと思われていた海洋生物が、地中での暮らしに適応進化して生き延びていた。雌が植物の根を摂取して体内で精油を作り、フェロモンとして求愛行動に用いることからこの名がついた。
entries.en: Marine life thought to have gone extinct in extreme antiquity survived by adapting and evolving to live underground. It got its name from the fact that the female ingests the roots of the plant and produces essential oil in her body which she uses as a pheromone in her courtship behavior.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アロマカリス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 狙撃銃を殻に仕込んだやどかり。殻の丈夫さから、足を止めての撃ちあいに強い。足が遅いため、狙撃に耐えられる生物相手には簡単に捕食されてしまう。
entries.en: They have a sniper rifle on their shells. Due to the strength of the shell it is strong enough to shoot at a standstill. Because of its slow legs it is easily preyed upon by creatures that can withstand the sniping.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: スナイプハーミット
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人に似た上半身を持ち、ニンゲンやヒトガタなどと呼ばれるが、巻貝の仲間。古代から陸上にも生息していたが透明なので気づかれなかったし、海で発見されても海洋哺乳類の見間違いだとされていた。
entries.en: It has an upper body that resembles a human and is called a ningen or hitokata but it is a member of the snail family. They've lived on land since ancient times but have gone unnoticed because they're so transparent and when they're found in the ocean they've been misidentified as marine mammals.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 透明ニンゲン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 高速で突進し、鋭い顎を突き刺してくる魚。人の頭蓋骨を余裕で貫通する。鋭い歯を持っておりインド象の鼻を食いちぎったケースも。完璧主義者であり、相手を仕留められないと刺さったまま回転して大暴れする。
entries.en: A fish that rushes at high speed and pierces you with its sharp maw. It can penetrate a person's skull at will. It has sharp teeth and in some cases it has bitten off the nose of an Indian elephant. They're perfectionists and if they can't finish off their opponents they'll go on a rampage stabbing and spinning.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ナインダツフィッシュ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 三途の川の終着点である、「冥海」出身。好奇心が強く、見知らぬ相手にも無邪気にジャレつくのだがそれがシャレにならない。巨体によるおふざけ突進や、鎧を圧砕する甘噛みに耐えられる者は少ないだろう。
entries.en: He is from the Land of the Dead the terminus of the Sanzu River. He has a strong curiosity and innocently plays games with strangers but is no joke. Few would be able to withstand the goofy rush of a huge body and the sweet bite that crushes armor.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 冥海魔オルチヌス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 温厚な性格で、毒針もないエイ。普段はエーテルの風に乗り低空を遊泳しながら空気中のマナや羽虫を食って生きているが、肉も食えないことはない。戦闘になると糸を撒いて敵の動きを止め、放電を行う。
entries.en: They are mild-mannered and have no poisonous needles. Normally they live off of mana and winged insects in the air as they swim low in the etheric winds but they are not incapable of eating meat either. When it comes to combat it stops the enemy's movement by scattering threads and discharging them.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イトマキシビレエイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 海底にたたずむ一輪の花。実際は珊瑚虫の群体である。藻類と共生しており、光合成も可能。色とりどりの外骨格を形成するが、生息しやすいようにと周囲に海水を撒きちらすので、あまり観賞には向かない。
entries.en: A single flower resting on the sea floor. In fact it is a group of coral worms. It lives in symbiosis with algae and is also capable of photosynthesis. It forms a multi-colored exoskeleton but it is not easily seen because it sprays seawater around it to make it habitable.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 花珊瑚
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 海のビッグスターを自称する巨大なヒトデ。最近、陸にはハムスターという人気者がいると聞いて、負けじと陸に上がってきた。手裏剣のことを寡黙な同族だと思い込んでいる。
entries.en: A giant starfish that calls itself the Big Star of the Sea. Recently it heard that there was a popular creature so he came up to not be outdone. He thinks of shuriken as a taciturn kindred spirit.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ビッグアビスター
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 海の犯罪者と呼ばれる。スリや食い逃げがメインだが、ある日やばすぎる犯罪を行ってしまい、現在は陸へ高飛び中。ほとぼりが冷めた頃に海に帰ろうと考えている。
entries.en: They are called the Criminals of the Sea. They''re mainly pickpockets and food runners but one day they commit a terrible crime and are now flying overland. They are thinking of returning to the sea when the heat has cooled down.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: タカトビウオ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 波の向くまま、気の向くままにさすらう海のガンマン。日光浴が大好きで、わざわざショートテレポートを連打して陸の岩の上まで寝そべりに行く。そして帰りに苦労する。
entries.en: A sea gunslinger who wanders at the direction of the waves and at his own whim. He loves to soak up the sun and deliberately goes to lie down on the rocks on the land with a series of short teleports. And struggle on the way home.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ガンマンボウ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 既存の忍術に縛られなくなったことで天性の才能が開花。よくわからないコードネームを名乗ってノリノリで活動している。…後年、クッションに顔を埋めて手足をバタバタさせてのた打ち回ることになりそうである。
entries.en: Her natural talent blossomed when she was no longer bound by existing ninjutsu. She goes by a code name that nobody understands and is in high spirits. ...In later years she's going to be burying her face in the cushion and lazing around.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 謎のお洒落忍者『シャドウシスター』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人間に友好的な犬の神。人間嫌いの弟と喧嘩になり、森を出て彷徨った結果メイルーンへ辿り着いた。吹雪で遭難した旅人を導いている内に一部地域で信仰されるようになったが、まだまだマイナーな神らしい。
entries.en: A dog god who is friendly to humans. He got into a fight with his brother who hates humans and wandered out of the forest resulting in his arrival in Mayroon. While guiding travelers who were lost in a blizzard the god came to be worshipped in some areas but it seems that it is still a minor god.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 白氷の『サイメーブ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神の欠片を宿す巨大なムカデ。欠片は毒と死者の守護神のものだったらしいが、そんなことはお構いなしに力に溺れて暴れまわる。人間にチヤホヤされている白銀龍蟲のことが嫌い。
entries.en: A giant centipede that harbors a piece of God. Apparently the pieces belonged to the guardian gods of venom and the dead but they don't care about that and go on a rampage drowning in power. It dislikes the white silver dragon bugs that are being flattered by humans.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: セパ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 束縛の悪魔から生まれたとされるワーム。ほぼ子供みたいなもの。特技は焦らしプレイであり、身動きの取れない獲物を少しずつ弱らせ、衰弱したところを頭から丸呑みにする。
entries.en: The worm is said to have been born from the demons of bondage. It's almost like a child. Their specialty is playing with impatience weakening their sluggish prey bit by bit and swallowing them head first when they are exhausted.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 束縛の魔蟲
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 遠目では丘と間違えられることもある、巨大なヒル。その巨躯のほとんどが吸った血なので、干からびるとかなり小さくなる。体型を維持するため必死に吸血する。
entries.en: A huge leech that could be mistaken for a hill at a distance. Since most of its massive frame is sucked blood it becomes quite small when it dries up. They desperately suck blood to maintain their body shape.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: グランド・ヒル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 巨大な触手のような姿のワーム。側面から生えているのは伸縮自在の副触手であり、脚ではない。粘着質の副触手で獲物の身体をまさぐりつつ、じっくりと生き血を吸って殺す。
entries.en: A worm that looks like a giant tentacle. Growing out of the sides are the elastic sub-tentacles not legs. They kill their prey with their sticky sub-tentacles slowly and deliberately sucking their lifeblood while pecking at their prey's body.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: テンタクルワーム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 自称、夜のエンターテイナー。仕える相手を次々に変え、骨抜きにして魔力を奪い取っていく悪魔のメイド。他のメイドたちに嫌われており、嫌味混じりに「魔女」と呼ばれている。チビなことが最大の悩み。
entries.en: She is a self-proclaimed night entertainer. A demon maid who transforms the partners she works with one after another stripping them of their bones and taking away their magical power. She is disliked by the other maids and is derisively referred to as a witch. Being small is her biggest annoyance.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エンタメイド・ウィッチビッチ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 悪魔のメイドたちを束ねる存在。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。特に拷問が得意で、人をさらってきてはペンチで爪や指や××や×××を容赦なくねじり切る。
entries.en: She is the one who binds the demon maids. She puts on a savage show to entertain her master who is always bored. She is particularly good at torture and when she snatches people up she uses pliers to twist their nails fingers x's and x's without mercy.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エンタメイド・ペンチーフ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 料理を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。獲物を生きたまま惨たらしく解体調理してしまう。暇な時は活きのいい獲物を探している。
entries.en: A demon maid in charge of cooking. They put on a gruesome show to entertain their master who is always bored. They savagely butcher and cook their prey alive. In their spare time they are looking for a lively prey.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エンタメイド・ザンコック
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 掃除を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。掃除は掃除でも、「侵入者の掃除」のほうも担当している。
entries.en: A demon maid who is in charge of cleaning. She puts on a gruesome show to entertain her master who is always bored. I'm also in charge of cleaning up the intruders.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エンタメイド・デスイーパー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 洗濯を担当する悪魔のメイド。いつも退屈している主人を楽しませるため、残虐ショーを披露する。衣服を洗うよりも、血で血を洗うことのほうが多い。
entries.en: A demon maid who is in charge of the laundry. They put on a gruesome show to entertain their master who is always bored. It is more about washing blood with blood than it is washing clothes.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エンタメイド・ブラッドレス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 魔王に仕えるインプの兵士。忠実で従順だが、面白みがない堅物ぞろいなので扱いは不遇。本人たちも気にしているのだが、不器用なのでどうしようもないらしい。
entries.en: An imp soldier in the service of the Demon King. They are loyal and obedient but they don't deserve to be treated well because they are an uninteresting bunch of stiffs. They are concerned about it but they are awkward and can't do anything about it.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 魔王の尖兵
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 弱ったヴァンパイアを身体ごと養分として吸収した結果、生物の血を啜る快楽に目覚めた南瓜の怪物。取り入れた血により自らを異常成長させ、さらなる獲物を狙う。
entries.en: As a result of absorbing the weakened vampire's entire body as nourishment the pumpkin monster has awakened to the pleasure of drinking a creature's blood. The blood he has taken in causes him to grow abnormally and he targets more prey.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヴァンプキン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キャロットに似たマンドレイクの一種。どこで習得したのか忍の技を身に着けているが、忍ぶつもりはさらさらない。後先考えず突っ走る癖がある。
entries.en: A type of mandrake that resembles a carrot. He is armed with ninja skills which he learned at some point but he has no intention of becoming a ninja. He has a habit of going ahead and not thinking ahead.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ニンジンジャー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 武人の魂を宿した勇猛なキュウリ。伝説生物カッパはこのキュウリの抵抗にあい滅んだことにされている。だが実際は食料不足で人里を荒らすようになったため人間に滅ぼされたのである。
entries.en: A brave cucumber with the soul of a warrior. It is believed that the legendary creature Kappa perished due to the resistance of these cucumber species. In reality however they were destroyed by humans because of a shortage of food which caused them to wreak havoc in the countryside.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キュウリー武人
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キュウリに自我が宿ったモンスター。夏になると亡霊を乗せて冥界からやってくるとされる。関節のない短い脚を懸命に動かして走る。走り続けると、汗で水分がどんどん抜けていく。
entries.en: A monster with an ego in a cucumber. It comes from the underworld with a ghost on its back in the summer. It runs with its short legs moving hard.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 胡瓜の怪物
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 皮を剥いたゴボウで生物の太ももあたりを叩く習性がある、意味不明な魔物。ゴボウの恨みを晴らすための儀式だとも、「お前の足ゴボウみたいだな」という挑発だとも言われているが、真相は不明。
entries.en: A monster with its soul in a cucumber. It is said that they come from the underworld in the summer with ghosts. They run hard on their short arthritic legs. If they keep running they''ll lose more and more water through sweat.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マンドレザッパー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 個人の記憶も、他人からの記憶も全て失った者の末路。彼らが何者だったのか、もうこの世界の誰にもわからない。本人の思考力が生まれたての赤ん坊と変わらないのがせめてもの救い。
entries.en: The end of a person who has lost all of his or her personal memories and those of others. Who they were no one in this world knows anymore. The only thing I can say is that his thinking ability is the same as that of a newborn baby.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 記憶の抜け殻
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 嫌な記憶を自他ともに消せる、その魅力に憑りつかれてしまった人々。少しでも苦しみや煩わしさを感じれば消してしまうのだとか。そんな生き方には、破滅しか待っていないような気がする。
entries.en: People who have become obsessed with the allure of being able to erase unpleasant memories of themselves and others. He said that if he feels even the slightest bit of pain or annoyance he will turn it off. I feel that there is nothing but ruin awaiting them in such a way of life.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 忘却信徒
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: あふれ出る狂気を抑えられず、絶えず顔面を掻き毟り、髪を振り乱し、獣のようにうめき声を発する。人としての知性は残っておらず、とある富豪にはライオンのようだとまで言われた。
entries.en: Unable to contain the overflowing madness he constantly scratches his face shakes his hair and moans like a beast. He had no human intelligence left and was even described by some affluent people as being like a lion.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 面忘の獅子
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 瀕死の魔獣が、その辺にいた婦人に勝手に憑りついた姿。記憶を消去して人格を乗っ取っている。この世界の記憶を全て消すのが任務であり、そのためにも失った力を取り戻そうと暗躍している。
entries.en: A dying monster possessed a woman who was nearby. They are erasing memories and hijacking personalities. She is on a mission to erase all memories of this world and to do so she is plotting to regain her lost power.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 傀儡巫女『メーイル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蒼い鎧を身に着けた鳥人。鎧には鳥の神の力を宿しているらしい。高速接近し、破壊の光を放ち、舞うように剣で敵を切り裂く。その猛々しさから、一部の地域では神同然の扱いを受けている。
entries.en: A bird-man wearing blue armor. It seems that the armor contains the power of the bird deity. Approaching at high speed it unleashes a destructive beam of light slashing through the enemy with its sword as it soars. Because of its ferocity it has been called a god in some parts of the world.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: トキガミ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 天上に住む半人半鳥の魔物。情緒不安定で、嫌なことがあると泣きながら恐ろしい歌を歌い、八つ当たりで地獄に堕ちた魂に永遠の罰を与える。カラヴィカより自分の方が歌が上手いと思っている。
entries.en: A half-human half-bird demon that dwells in the sky. They''re emotionally unstable crying and singing horrible songs when they don't want to and inflicting eternal punishment on souls damned to hell to vent. They think they can sing better than Karavika.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アルコノスト
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 翼までも覆う黒い鎧を身に着けた鳥人の拳闘士。自分の拳にやたら自信があるようで、自分より強い相手にも平気で殴りかかる。戦闘で破壊されないような、もっと強固な鎧が欲しいと思っている。
entries.en: A bird-man brawler wearing black armor that covers even his wings. He seems to have a lot of confidence in his fists and he doesn't mind striking out at opponents stronger than him. He wants more solid armor that won't be destroyed in battle.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ブラックウィング
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 恋も知らずに幼くして死んだ少女の魂が転生したもの。獲物を誘惑し、油断したところを攻撃する。頭部を砕いて脳髄を吸うのが好き、となかなかにアグレッシブ。
entries.en: The reincarnation of the soul of a girl who died at an early age without knowing love. They lure their prey and attack them when they are caught off guard. They like to crush the head and suck the brain tissue and they are quite aggressive.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: モー・ショボー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 食べ歩きと剣客商売をしながら様々な星を渡り歩く剣士。普通の腕の他に、肩から伸びる２本の触手を用いて戦う。根っからの戦闘種族なのだが、性格は呑気。胃酸が特殊で、幻覚成分を含むゲップが出る。
entries.en: A swordsman who travels the various stars while eating and peddling swords. In addition to his normal arms he fights with two tentacles that extend from his shoulders. He is a warrior at heart but his personality is a bit of a drinker. Stomach acid is special and burps with a hallucinogenic component.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 宇宙剣客『ベルファート』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 波動を操る力を身に着けた竜人の戦士。すさまじい戦闘力を誇るが、なぜそんな力が身についたのか、そもそも何の波動なのか、本人もよくわかっていない。
entries.en: A dragon warrior who has acquired the power to manipulate wave motion. He boasts tremendous fighting power but even he doesn't know how he got this power or what the waves are in the first place.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 波動竜戦士
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 体温が上がらないとテンションが上がらないので、周囲の熱を吸収して冷気に変えて放出する。複数体集まれば熱い地域にも吹雪を起こせるほどになる。
entries.en: When their body temperature doesn't rise their tension doesn't rise so they absorb the heat around them turn it into cold air and release it. If you collect more than one of them it's enough to cause a blizzard in a hot area.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ブリザード
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 大剣を振るうパワフルな竜人。大剣のずっしりとした重さが好き。自分の腕に自信を持っており、ドラゴンと戦ったりドラゴンハンターと戦ったりと見境がない。
entries.en: A powerful dragon man wielding a greatsword. He likes the sturdy weight of the greatsword. He is confident in his skills and has no reservations when it comes to fighting dragons and dragon hunters.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ドラゴクレイモア
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 竜人の暗殺者。竜人限定の暗殺者ギルドを作り、一族の脅威となる者を暗殺して回っている。シッポが邪魔で群衆に紛れることができないため、ステルス能力のある服を愛用している。
entries.en: Assassin of the Dragon Man. They have formed an assassin's guild for dragon people only and they go around assassinating those who pose a threat to the clan. Their tails are in the way and they can't blend in with the crowd so they prefer clothes with stealthy abilities.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アサシンリザード
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 火を吐くことに憧れ、火炎の力を身に着けようとして全身の鱗が熱で焦げるほどの修行をした。結局ダメだったことに絶望して性格が歪んでしまい、結果的に吐けるようになったのは毒だけだった。
entries.en: He longed to breathe fire and cultivated so much that the scales on his entire body burned with heat in an attempt to acquire the power of the flame. In the end his personality was warped in despair that it didn't work and the only thing that resulted in him being able to throw up was poison.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 黒鱗の毒含竜
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 頑張って魔法を身に着けた竜人。とはいえ肉体がもともと強靭なので、魔法攻撃よりも物理攻撃のほうが強い。そのことに長い間葛藤した結果、補助魔法を使う形に落ち着いた。
entries.en: The dragon man has worked hard to acquire magic. However since his body is strong to begin with his physical attacks are more powerful than his magical attacks. After struggling with that for a long time he settled on using auxiliary magic.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: リザードメイジ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 妖精族に危機迫る時、光の衣を纏って泉から生まれるという伝説の妖精。ただし他種族の台頭により、ここ数百年断続的に生まれてきている。本人たちは希少性の低下に悩んでいる模様。
entries.en: Legend has it that when a fairy tribe was threatened she was born from a spring clothed in a robe of light. However due to the rise of other races they have been born sporadically over the past few hundred years. They are suffering from diminishing numbers.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 光輝の妖精
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 赤く燃えているくらいで、見た目こそ普通の妖精とそう変わらないが、通常の妖精の6000倍以上の質量を持つ。ものすごい勢いで特攻してくるので、頑張って避けよう。
entries.en: It burns red and although it looks no different from a normal fairy it has more than 6000 times the mass of a normal fairy. It attacks with great force so try your best to avoid it.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: フェアリーゴラス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 火の元素から生まれた妖精。その証拠に火の魔法が使える。男は威厳があり、女は美しいとされる。ほぼ人間と同じサイズであり、人間と結婚することも珍しくない。
entries.en: A fairy born of the fire element. To prove it it will use fire magic. Men are said to be dignified and women are said to be beautiful. They are almost the same size as humans and it is not uncommon for them to marry humans.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ペリ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 先天的な病気で、成長抑制因子が正常に機能しなかった妖精。人間大にまで成長してしまい、やむなく妖精の里から出るはめになった。魔法も上手く使えないので、専ら人間用の弓などで戦う。
entries.en: A fairy with a congenital disease that prevented its growth inhibitors from functioning properly. They have grown to the size of a human and have had to leave the fairy home. They can''t use magic very well so they fight with human bows.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ギガントフェアリー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 洗礼を受けずに死んだ子供の魂が転生したものとされる。人間にいたずらをするのが大好きだが、義理堅く仕事熱心な性格。月光を浴びながら集団で踊る。
entries.en: It is said to be the reincarnation of the soul of an unbaptized and dead child. They love to play pranks on humans but they are loyal and hardworking. They dance in groups while basking in the moonlight.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ピクシー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 奇跡的に人格を取り戻したが、肉体的には既に人外。肉体制御によって人間だった頃の姿を再現しているにすぎない。兄による外部神経調整でメシェーラの影響をどうにか抑え込んでいる。
entries.en: She has miraculously regained her personality but she is already physically out of her element. She is merely recreating what she looked like when she was human through bodily control. External neural adjustments by her brother somewhat suppressed Meshera's influence.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 抑圧されし災厄『レナイ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 階級以上の実力を持つが、上司のパワハラを受けてなかなか昇進できない。現在は労働環境の改善を求めてストライキ中。最近はいっそ悪魔陣営からのスカウトに応じようかなとも考えている。
entries.en: He has the ability to be above his rank but is unable to get promoted due to power harassment from his boss. They are currently on strike for better working conditions. Recently he's been thinking about accepting scouts from the Demon Squad.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 堕天使
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キューピッドたちが適正な恋愛成就活動をしているか、監督査察するのが役目。昔は割となあなあでやっていたが、近年はトラブルが表面化してきたため、厳しくなりつつある。
entries.en: The role is to supervise Cupid and the others to make sure that they are doing their best to achieve love. In the past they used to be able to do it with ease but in recent years they have become more strict because of the troubles that have come to the surface.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 愛の監察官
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 一人前の天使を目指している。競争社会に放り込まれ、勝ち抜いたエリートだけが正天使になれるのだが、その先にも辛いことや苦しいことやとても辛いことや死ぬほど苦しいことが待っていることを知らない。
entries.en: He aims to be a full-fledged angel. Only the elite who are thrown into a competitive society and win out can become true angels but they don't know that there will be pain hardship extreme hardship and even deathly hardship ahead.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 見習い天使
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蛙の神。戦闘力は大したことないのだが、天災を予知する天才と呼ばれ近年まで崇められてきた。あまりに心配性なため、自分の身に危険が迫ると発狂して暴れだす。
entries.en: God of frogs. Although he is not a great fighter he has been called a genius at predicting natural disasters and has been revered until recently. He is so anxious that when he is in danger he goes crazy and goes on a rampage.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: セイアシン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 熱利用攻撃を得意とするが、非戦闘時には身体に熱がこもってしまう。普段は当たりかまわず熱を発散し、寝る時は冷却のため水中の巣に帰る。見た目のせいで溶岩の中に住んでいるとよく誤解される。
entries.en: It specializes in using heat to attack but when it is not in combat its body becomes feverish. Normally they radiate heat without incident and when they sleep they return to their underwater nests for cooling. It is often misunderstood that they live in lava because of their appearance.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 沙羅曼蛇
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 沼の王と呼ばれる巨大生物。その正体はメルカサラマンダーが先祖帰りを起こした姿。ぬおーっとした雰囲気に似合わず、力がやたら強い。素揚げにすると結構イケるとのことで、珍味として売られる場合も。
entries.en: A giant creature called the King of the Swamp. Its true identity is the shape of the Melka Salamander that caused the ancestral return. It doesn't suit the languid atmosphere but it has a lot of power. It is said that it is quite good when deep-fried without sauce and sometimes it is sold as a delicacy.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヌオウ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 魔力で音を操るというオタマジャクシ。空気を激しく振動させ、その衝撃を攻撃に転用する。魔力で浮遊しているが、成長しても飛び蛙になったりはしない。
entries.en: The tadpole is said to manipulate sound by magic. It vibrates the air violently converting its force into an attack. It floats by magic but doesn't become a flying frog when it grows up.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 音魔杓子
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 自身の身体から分泌される毒液を用いて狩りをする珍しい蛙。派手な体色を嫌がっているが、毒を作る過程でこういう色になってしまうので仕方がないらしい。
entries.en: A rare frog that hunts using a poisonous liquid secreted by its own body. They don't like the flashy color of their bodies but apparently it can't be helped because the process of making the poison turns out to be this color.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 毒矢蛙
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エレアの母とノーランドの父を持つ。両親の才能を受け継いでいるのか、若くしてとんでもない腕っぷしを誇る。アリベル七箇条という独自のルール・心構えを持っているが、これは父親の教えを参考にしたらしい。
entries.en: She has a mother of Elea and a father of Norland. She may have inherited the talents of her parents but she is also proud of her skill at a young age. Aribel has her own rules and mindset called the Seven Articles which she refers to as her father's teachings.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 腕白少女『アリベル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 肉体から分離した生霊の成れの果て。元は高貴な魔法使いだったようで、強い魔力を持つ。特に力の強い個体は君主級として区別され、アークの接頭辞をつけられる。
entries.en: The end of the life spirit that separated from the body. It seems he was a noble wizard in the past and has strong magical powers. Particularly powerful individuals are distinguished as monarchs and are prefixed with arch.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アークレイス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 「軍団」と呼称される悪霊。群れを作って生者を襲い、新たな仲間として取り込んでいく習性がある。一定数以上になると別グループが誕生する。自我が薄れており、他の個体と自分との区別が曖昧。
entries.en: An evil spirit called The Legion. They have a habit of attacking the living in packs and taking them in as new companions. When there is more than a certain number another group is born. The ego is fading and the distinction between oneself and other individuals is blurred.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: レギオンメイジ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 階段で死んだ者たちの思念集合体。階段から階段へと移り潜り込む。疲労した通行人を階段から突き落とすのが趣味だが、暇だと普通に襲い掛かってくることもある。
entries.en: The thought-gathering of those who died on the stairs. I move from staircase to staircase and dive in. Their hobby is to push tired passersby down the stairs but when they have nothing to do they will usually pounce on them.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 『13段目の悪霊』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 風のルルウィに捕獲・調教された、哀れな風の精霊。食事もろくに与えられず生かさず殺さずの状態で飼育されている。理性をほぼ失っており、食べられそうなものがあれば生きようと必死で食らいつく。
entries.en: A pitiful wind spirit who was captured and trained by Lulwy of the Wind. They are not fed much and are kept lifeless but not dead. It has almost lost all sense of rationality and if there is anything it can be eaten it is eaten in a desperate attempt to survive.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: シルフ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 秘術によってアンデッドとなり悠久の時を過ごす。禁忌の研究をまとめた彼女の著書は、暗号のように難解ゆえシズルコードと呼ばれている。才能ある魔法使いが読むとその内容に強く魅了されてしまうため危険。
entries.en: She became an undead through mystic arts and lived for an eternity. Her book a compilation of research on abstinence is called The Ssil Code because it is as esoteric as a code. It is dangerous for a gifted wizard to read it because they will be strongly enchanted by its contents.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 破禁の魔女『シズル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 外見こそ試作型と変わらないが、様々なパーツの互換が効くようになっている。次元歪曲ユニットを外して電子戦装備や重火器を積むことも可能であり、汎用戦闘機としても優秀。
entries.en: The appearance is the same as the prototype but various parts are interchangeable. It is also possible to carry heavy weapons and electronic warfare equipment to remove the dimensional distortion unit and is also excellent as a general-purpose fighter.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 量産型メルガスト
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 薬物への逃避衝動と深い悲しみを振り払い、再び空へ羽ばたく白き鷹。後遺症の影響を受けながらも、確実に全盛期の実力を取り戻しつつある。
entries.en: A white hawk that shakes off the urge to flee to drugs and deep sorrow and flutters into the sky again. Despite being affected by the aftereffects he is steadily regaining the power he had in his prime.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 白き鷹『ヴェセル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 束縛するのもされるのも大好き、という倒錯的な悪魔。神々に巨城へ叩き込まれたのだが、他の悪魔ほど力が制限されていない。持ち前の能力のせいで効き目が弱かったのだと思われる。
entries.en: She is a perverted demon who loves to be both bound and treated. She was thrown into a giant castle by the gods but her powers are not as limited as the other demons. It seems that the effect was less effective because of the ability she possessed.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 束縛の悪魔『エゲルベイル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 恐怖の体現者。構ってちゃんであり、寂しくなると死んでしまうからなどという理由（もちろん嘘である）で誰彼構わず引き寄せ、阿鼻叫喚の地獄を作り出す。
entries.en: The embodiment of fear. It is a caring person and when it gets lonely it will die etc. A lie of course. So it attracts everyone and creates a hell of a scene.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ドレッドラビット
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: かつて神々の大戦時に、風の女神に敗北してしまい身体を引き裂かれた虹の女神…その破片を宿すリス。生まれたばかりの頃は破片の支配力が強いため、身体が虹色に発光する。
entries.en: The goddess of the rainbow once defeated by the goddess of the wind in a great war between the gods which tore her body apart...these squirrels houses the pieces. When they are newborn their bodies glow a rainbow of colors due to the dominance of the fragments.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イリス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 真っ白な兎。神として祭り上げられたことにより微弱ながらも神力を持つ。祖先の記憶が遺伝子に強く刷り込まれており、サメが苦手。縁結びが特技らしい。
entries.en: A pure white rabbit. It has a weak but divine power because it was raised as a god. Ancestral memories are strongly imprinted in its genes and it is not good at sharks. They are said to be good at matching couples.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 白兎神
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 兎社会に潜む怪物。夜な夜な墓を掘り返して遺体を食らうため、屍食兎とも呼ばれる。兎だけでなく他の生物をも魅了し、食料としてしまう。
entries.en: A monster lurking in rabbit society. They are also called corpse-eating rabbits because they dig up graves at night and devour the bodies. It attracts not only rabbits but also other creatures and uses them as food.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: バニーグール
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: リスこそが地上で最も尊い生物であるという考えのもとに行動する。土地の明け渡しと無条件降伏をあちこちに要求したが、当然拒否されたため無差別破壊活動に走った。
entries.en: They act on the idea that squirrels are the most noble creatures on earth. They demanded land surrender and unconditional surrender but were naturally refused so they went on an indiscriminate subversive campaign.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: テロリス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 兎と亀の合成獣。遥か昔に兎と亀の徒競走があったらしいが、もしその場にこの生物がいた場合、結果はどうなっていただろうか。全ては亀のみぞ…もとい、神のみぞ知る。
entries.en: A synthetic beast of a rabbit and a tortoise. There was a race between a rabbit and a tortoise a long time ago and I wonder what the outcome would have been if this creature had been there. All things are in the hands of the tortoise... and God knows.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: タートルラビット
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鏡の世界に住む巨大蝙蝠。サバイバルを繰り返し、こちら側の世界にも適応した。疾風の如く空を駆ける。執着心が強く、一度捕食しようとした獲物は徹底的に狙う。
entries.en: The giant bat lives in the mirror world. It has adapted to this side of the world through repeated survival. It flies in the sky like a swift wind. They are obsessive and once they have attempted to prey on their prey they target them thoroughly.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ダークレイダー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蝙蝠の神。闇にまぎれて、病気や悪魔から人々を守るヒーロー。普通の蝙蝠と間違われて、守るべき人々からよく攻撃されるのが悩みの種。特技は死んだふり。
entries.en: The bat god. A hero who under the cover of darkness protects people from disease and demons. It often gets mistaken for a normal bat and is attacked by the people it is supposed to protect. It's good at playing dead.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カパプカムイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人間たちが戦争している様子を遠巻きに観察して、戦闘技術を独自に学んだ蝙蝠。銃の扱いを覚えたが、兵士たちの口汚い罵倒まで覚えてしまった。
entries.en: Bats have learned their own fighting skills by observing the humans at war from a distance. They learned how to handle the guns and even learned the foul-mouthed abuse of the soldiers.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: コンバット
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: やけにでかい蝙蝠だと思ったら、なんと妖怪らしい。樹の穴に住み、子供の泣き声で人々をおびき寄せる。気に入った子供はさらい、そうでない子供や大人には噛みついてくる。
entries.en: It looks to be a very large bat but it seems to be a monster. They live in a hole in the tree and lure people in with the cries of children. Kids who like it will be snatched and kids and adults who don't will be bitten by it.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: モモツカ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 究極の力に目覚めたネズミ。普通のネズミと大きさはそう変わらないが戦闘力は段違い。さらに、「究鼠猫を噛み殺し、ついでにインド象も殺す」というコトワザがあるくらい凶暴。
entries.en: The rats have awakened to their ultimate power. It's no different in size from a normal rat but it's fighting power is much different. In addition there is a saying that they bite and kill the ultimate rat cat and eventually kill the Indian elephant.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 究鼠
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 災厄の象徴とされる巨大ハムスター。その旺盛な食欲と繁殖力により一帯の食物を食い尽くしてしまう。さらに、伸び続ける前歯を削るため樹木や柱にかじりつくので、森も建物も残らない。
entries.en: A giant hamster that is considered a symbol of disaster. Its voracious appetite and fecundity will devour the food in the area. In addition the trees and pillars are gnawed by the ever-growing front teeth so no forests or buildings are left behind.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ディザスター
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 老いたハムスターが化けたもの。ハムスターの世界では、ハム将軍に仕える最高位の存在。遊ぶためにしょっちゅう脱走していなくなるので、代わりが何匹もいる。
entries.en: An elderly hamster disguised as an older hamster. In the hamster world he is the highest ranking being in the service of General Ham. They often escape to play so there are a number of substitutes.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ハム大老
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 初代ミノタウロスの別名と同じ名前を持つ牛人。星、雷光を意味する名前。ミノタウロスの中でも神がかり的な強さを持つ者だけが、こう名乗ることを許されている。
entries.en: A cattleman with the same name as the alias of the first Minotaur. The name means star or thunderbolt. Only those with divine strength among the minotaurs are allowed to call themselves so.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アステリオス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人の身体に牛の頭と蹄を持つ。今でこそ化け物扱いだが、元は武器の神。性格は勇敢で忍耐強く、霧を操る能力を持つ。
entries.en: A human body with the head and hooves of a cow. He is now a monster but he was once a god of weapons. His personality is brave and patient and he has the ability to control the fog.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: シユウ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 青い身体にものすごい力を秘めた雄牛。自分の力を制御できないことでブルーになり、よくブルブル震えている。直接話したことはないが、ブルーバブルにはなんだか親近感を覚えている。
entries.en: A bull with a blue body and tremendous power. They are blue from not being able to control their own power and are often burbling and shaking. I've never spoken to them directly but I feel somehow familiar with the Blue Bubble.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ブルーブル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 超古代の頃から搾乳や精肉のために家畜として扱われている。ミノタウロスたちからは祖先として神聖視されており、牛を解放するためにミノタウロスが人を襲うこともあるのだとか。
entries.en: They have been domesticated for milking and for meat since ancient times. The cattle are considered sacred as ancestors by the minotaurs and the minotaurs sometimes attack people in order to free the cattle.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 牛
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ケンタウロスの中では珍しく、魔術と近接戦闘術に秀でる。派手好きな性格で、元からピカピカの鎧をさらに魔力でもって発光させている。基本的に雄しかいない。
entries.en: Rare among the centaurs he excels in magic and melee combat. He has a flair for flamboyance making his original shiny armor glow with even more magical power. Basically there are only males.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マスタリオン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 闇の力を得て強化された馬。その実力は未知数で、世間一般からは大して注目されていないし期待もされていない。一方、ダークホース自身はそんな評価を気にしていない。馬耳東風というやつである。
entries.en: A horse that has been strengthened with the power of darkness. His abilities are unknown and he does not receive much attention or expectation from the general public. Dark Horse itself on the other hand isn't concerned about that assessment.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ダークホース
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 全身鎧を身に着けたケンタウロス。単騎での戦いを好み、プライドも戦闘力も高い。よほど馴れた相手でもない限り、胴体に乗せることを嫌う。
entries.en: A centaur wearing full body armor. He prefers to fight alone and has a high level of pride and fighting power. He doesn't like to be put on his armor unless his opponent is very skilled.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ケンタウロスの騎士
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 小さめのバリスタであれば単独で扱えるように訓練された軍馬。馬の筋力を持ってしてもバリスタは相当重いらしく、足を止めて構えないと撃てない模様。
entries.en: A military horse trained to handle a small ballista on its own. Even with the muscle strength of a horse the ballista seems to be quite heavy and it cannot be shot unless it stops its feet and takes a posture.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: バリスタリオン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 弓矢から銃に乗り換えたケンタウロス。疾走しながら遠方のインド象の眉間を撃ち抜くなど、反射神経と運動能力に秀でる。好きなものはボルトアクション。
entries.en: The centaurs have switched from bows and arrows to guns. It excels in reflexes and athleticism such as shooting a distant Indian elephant between the eyebrows while sprinting. Their favorite thing is bolt action.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ガンタウロス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 半人半馬の生物。普通の馬より重心が前にあるため、前傾姿勢を取ろうものならひっくり返りそうになる。群れで狩猟や農耕をして生活する。
entries.en: A half-man half-horse creature. Their center of gravity is more forward than a normal horse so if they try to lean forward they might fall over. They live by hunting and farming in herds.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ケンタウロス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: パンを愛しすぎた精霊が、焼きたてのパンと一つになった姿。パンの構成物質の６割が、ショクパンヨリフランスパンという謎の超硬度物質に変化している。硬さを活かして体当たりで物を破壊する。
entries.en: A spirit who loved the bread too much became one with the freshly baked bread. Sixty percent of the bread's constituents have been transformed into a mysterious super-hard substance called shoku panyori French bread. He uses his hardness to destroy objects with his body hit.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: パンの精霊
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 無数の魂と融合したウィスプ。怒りや憎悪に狂った魂の影響で、激しく燃え盛る。動きは緩慢だが、相手の魂ごと肉体を引き寄せるため逃げ切るのは難しい。
entries.en: A wisp fused with countless souls. It burns fiercely under the influence of a soul crazed with anger and hatred. Its movements are slow but it is difficult to escape because it pulls the body and soul of the opponent towards it.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 荒鬼火
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 極限にまで発達した放電雲が、多量の水蒸気を取り込んで変容した姿。天候に大きな影響を及ぼす。風の吹くまま気の向くまま、流されるように上空を浮遊しながら鳥を狩って生活する。
entries.en: An extremely developed discharge cloud that has been transformed by taking in a large amount of water vapor. It has a huge impact on the weather. They live by hunting birds while hovering in the air as if they were being swept away by the wind whenever the wind blows.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クラウドラゴン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: コアから四方に延びたモアイが特徴的。モアイ部分は推進装置であるとともに強固な盾。コアがダメージを受けないように、モアイの石頭で攻撃を受け止める。
entries.en: It features a moai extending from the core on all four sides. The moai part is a strong shield as well as a propulsion device. To prevent the core from taking damage the moai's stone head parries the attack.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヴァイフコア
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 複雑な魔法回路が刻まれており、板部分に膨大な魔力を溜めることができる。仮初の生命を与えられており、自律行動が可能。前線への魔力補給装置や施設用魔力電池として秘密裏に試験運用されている。
entries.en: A complex magic circuit is carved into the board and a huge amount of magic can be stored in the board. It has been given a provisional life and is capable of autonomous action. It is secretly tested and operated as a magical power supply device for the front lines and as a magical power battery for facilities.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マナモノリス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 地雷を撒きまくる困ったモアイ。必要以上に強力なセンサーを搭載しており、自身は地雷に引っかからない。地雷犬からライバル視されているが、そのことについては特に興味がない模様。
entries.en: A troubled moai scattering landmines. With sensors that are more powerful than necessary he doesn't get caught by mines himself. He is regarded as a rival by landmine dogs but he doesn't seem to care about that.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クレイモアイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 先代の収穫の神が使役していた魔物。大雨の夜、首のない死体から一斉に生えてきたという。関連する伝承が世界各地に多く残っており、今日では死神というと一般的にこの魔物のことを指す。
entries.en: A demon that was used by the previous god of harvest. It is said that on a night of heavy rains a batch of headless corpses grew out of them. Many related lore survives throughout the world and today the term reaper generally refers to this demon.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 刈り取る者
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 死を超越しようとして禁忌に手を出した者の成れの果て。シズルコードと呼ばれる魔術書を一部解読し、その秘術でアンデッドを身体に取り込んだが失敗。本当は綺麗に融合し、３対の翼が生えてくるはずだった。
entries.en: It is the result of those who try to transcend death and meddle with the taboo. He deciphered a part of a magic book called the Ssil Code and used its magic to bring the undead into his body but failed. In truth they should have fused beautifully and sprouted three pairs of wings.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 冒涜の魔導亡者
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: どこかのネクロマンサーが作った、ツギハギの幽鬼。名前もそのまま、古代の人造語で「ツギハギ」という意味である。無理に取り付けたため身体はアンバランス。自我はアンバランスどころか崩壊済み。
entries.en: A gnarled ghost created by a necromancer somewhere. The name is also intact meaning Tsugihagi in an ancient artificial language. The body is unbalanced due to the forced installation. The ego is far from unbalanced it's broken.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ミクシフォーナ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 国同士の抗争で使い潰されていくことに疑問を持ち、同志を集めて傭兵団を結成した。優れたサバイバビリティで戦友達を何度も救っており、彼を師と仰ぐ傭兵も多い。傭兵の仕事がない時は実家で農業をしている。
entries.en: Concerned about being consumed by the war between the nations he gathered his comrades and formed a mercenary group. He has saved his comrades many times with his superior survivorship and many mercenaries look up to him as a mentor. When he's not working as a mercenary he's farming at his parents' house.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 歴戦の傭兵『シュライダ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 黒いオーラの部分が本体。バフォメットの死骸を操って活動する。細菌を魔術で生成・制御して甚大な被害をもたらす。だが扱うのが封印当時の細菌ベースで、制御なしだとイルヴァの現代生物にはほぼ効かない。
entries.en: The black aura is the main body. It operates by manipulating the corpse of Baphomet. The germs are generated and controlled by magic to cause great damage. But the infection is based on germs from the time of the sealing and without control it is almost ineffective against modern creatures in Irva.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 疫病の悪魔『ロアトニス』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 闇魔術で徹底的に強化されたなめくじ。どこかの悪質な魔法使いが面白半分で作り出し、野外に放ったものが大繁殖した。野生のかたつむりたちからは「なんか暗くて近寄りがたい」と思われている。
entries.en: A slug that has been thoroughly enhanced with dark magic. A vicious wizard somewhere created it for fun and released it into the open air where it multiplied greatly. The wild beetles think it's dark and unapproachable.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ダークネスラッグ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 元は普通の殻だったが、人間に依頼して高性能な大砲と機銃を搭載したかたつむり。残念ながらバランス制御が困難で扱いきれず、機銃を単発で撃つのが精一杯の模様。
entries.en: Originally an ordinary shell the snail was equipped with a high-powered cannon and machine gun at the request of humans. Unfortunately the balance control is too difficult to handle and it seems that it is all it can do is shoot the machine gun in single shots.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: フォートレスネイル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: かたつむり一族繁栄につながると信じて命を懸ける。殻の中に爆薬を詰め込んで突進するが、大抵は接近する前に処理されてしまう。その命は風に舞い散るほど軽い…。
entries.en: They believe that this will lead to the prosperity of the Snail family and they are willing to put their lives on the line. They charge at you with explosives packed into their shells but most of the time they are dealt with before you can approach them. Its life is so light that it flutters in the wind...
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神風舞々
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 外敵に会ったりつつかれたりすると、身体から強烈な酸性の液を噴出して身を守ろうとする。その酸攻撃で余計な怒りを買って殺されてしまうことも多い。
entries.en: When meeting or being poked by an outside enemy the body spurts out an intense acidic liquid to protect itself. That acid attack often causes extra anger and gets them killed.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 酸性雨フラシ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 魔力を蓄えた珍しいかたつむり。かたつむりのくせに魔法をそれなりに使うことができる。これなら野生でも生き残れる…と思いきや、食べると魔法に強くなれる性質があるため食用にされることが多い。
entries.en: A rare snail that has accumulated magical power. Even though it is a snail it is able to use magic in its own way. It is often eaten because of its magical properties that make it stronger when eaten.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マジカルゴ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 海のかたつむり。殻は退化して体の中に内蔵されている。食べられないことはないが、そのままでは味がほとんどない上に毒がある。海水には適応しているが、濃い塩を浴びるとやはり助からない。
entries.en: The snail of the sea. The shell has degenerated and is housed in the body. It's never eaten but it has almost no flavor as it is and is poisonous. It is adaptable to seawater but it does not help if it is exposed to thick salt.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: オオアメフラシ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前の記憶を求めて現文明以前から彷徨っている。その完成度は芸術品レベルであり、量産型のゾンビなどとは比較にならない力を持つ。
entries.en: Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. She has been wandering around since before the present civilization in search of memories of her past. Its perfection is a work of art level with powers that cannot be compared to mass-produced zombies.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ゾンビ少女
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前のままの自我をもつ。製造の際に歪んだ食欲を植え付けられており、ゾンビだろうが人だろうが意思とは裏腹に本能的に捕食してしまう。
entries.en: Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. It has the ego as it was when it was alive. They have been instilled with a distorted appetite during manufacturing and instinctively prey on zombies or people against their will.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ゴシック
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: スライムの一種を用い、少女の死体をつなぎ合わせて作られた。生前の少女の人格を持つが、心が狂気に蝕まれている。高い射撃能力を後天的に植え付けられたタイプであり、後方から地味に仕事をする。
entries.en: Using a type of slime it was created by piecing together the corpse of a girl. She takes on the persona of a girl who was alive but her mind is consumed by madness. She is the type who was born with a high shooting ability and works calmly from the rear.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: レクイエム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 選りすぐりの人体パーツを用いて作られた、最強のサヴァント。簡易的にだがネクロマンシーを使用することもできる。エリートであることに誇りを持っているが、実際はただの当て馬であることを知らない。
entries.en: The strongest Savant made using a selection of human body parts. It can also use necromancy albeit briefly. It takes pride in being an elite but doesn't know that it's actually just a guessing horse.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: サヴァントクイーン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 伝説的なまでに勝利に飢えた狼。恐ろしく負けず嫌い。気を練ることで体を硬化させることができるが、これは巨大化の技をかなり間違えて習得した結果のようだ。
entries.en: A wolf with a legendary hunger for victory. He is a terrible loser. It is possible to harden the body by practicing chi but this seems to be the result of learning the giantization technique in a rather incorrect way.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 伝説の餓狼
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 他人の心を覗き見、復讐心を食らって操る悪魔。内心は復讐を馬鹿らしく思っており、自身を封印した神々に対しても復讐は考えていない。誘いに乗らない者に出会うと興味を示し、執着する。
entries.en: A demon that peers into the minds of others and manipulates them with a vengeful spirit. Deep down she thinks revenge is a fool's errand and she has no intention of taking revenge on the gods who sealed her. When she meets someone who doesn't take her up on her offer she shows interest and becomes obsessed.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 復讐の悪魔『インクツァル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 群れの中で殺し合う性質を持つ種類のカラス。そのなかで最後に生き残った一羽がこう呼ばれる。先天的に戦闘適正に優れており、ドミナントとも呼ばれる。
entries.en: A type of crow that has the tendency to kill each other in flocks. The last one to survive is called this. They are also called the dominant because they have congenital combat skills.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ラストレイヴン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ペンギンのペンギンによるペンギンのための国を作るため旅をするペンギンの戦士。寒いところが好みなのだが、暑いところでも根性で活動する。飛ぶことができないが、泳ぐのは非常に上手い。
entries.en: A penguin warrior who travels to make a country for penguins by penguins penguins. They prefer the cold but they will work with guts even in the heat. They can''t fly but they're very good swimmers.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 放浪ペンギン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 王宮お抱えの魔法使い。才能の塊のような存在で、幼少の頃から膨大な魔力を自在に扱えた者も少なくない。有事の際には王宮の守護も行う。
entries.en: He is a wizard at the royal palace. He is like a mass of talent and there are few who have been able to handle the enormous amount of magic at will since childhood. He is also the guardian of the royal palace in case of emergency.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 王宮魔導士
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 生まれつき魔法の才能に劣るエウダーナ兵。弓で戦闘力を補っている。魔法使いと見なされておらず、本国における扱いは最低クラス。そのため不満と嫉妬を抱えている。
entries.en: A soldier of Eulderna who was born with an inferior talent for magic. He supplemented his fighting power with a bow. He is not considered a wizard and his treatment in his home country is of the lowest class. Because of this he is frustrated and jealous.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エウダーナ魔弓兵
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神々の大戦で散った天使の、力の欠片と名前を受け継ぐ熊。その名は「熊の神」を意味する。弩砲を使いこなすパワーを持つが魔法はてんで使えない。
entries.en: A bear that inherits a piece of power and a name from an angel that was scattered in the Great War of the Gods. Its name means God of the Bear. He has the power to use the crossbow but is completely incapable of using magic.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ドビエル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 闇喰コアラの群れを統率する最強の闇喰コアラ。餌場や襲撃場所を決定し、群れを導く役割を持つ。棒状のものを振り回したがる習性がある。お肌に気を使っているのか、サラサラのパウダーを使用しているようだ。
entries.en: The strongest dark-eating koala leads a herd of dark-eating koalas. They are responsible for deciding where to feed and raid and guiding the herd. It has a habit of swinging a stick-shaped object. They seem to care about their skin and use a silky powder.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 『コアラの指揮者』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人の味を覚えてしまった大熊。人家周囲に積極的に現れるうえ、非常に執着心が強い。悪い神と見なされ太古の昔から人々に駆逐されてきた。
entries.en: A big bear has learned a taste for people. They appear actively around people's houses and are extremely obsessive. They are considered evil gods and have been hunted down by the people since time immemorial.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ウェンカムイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 遺跡から発見された生体兵器。ボディの一部が機械や装甲に置き換えられた虎。獣の俊敏さを生かした連続突進を避けるのは困難。ぎらぎらと発光していることからその名がつけられたようだ。
entries.en: Bioweapons discovered in the ruins. A tiger whose body has been partially replaced by a machine or armor. It's hard to avoid continuous rushes with the agility of a beast. It seems to have been named after the glittering lights.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: グレア
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ライオンをベースとして呪術で生み出された合成獣。人並の知能…というより完全に人の知性を有しており、生み出される際にいったいどんなことが行われたのか気になるところである。
entries.en: A synthetic beast based on a lion and spawned through magic. It has the intelligence of a human or rather the intelligence of a complete human and it is curious to know what was done when it was created.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 呪縛のマンティコア
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カーバンクルの亜種であり、より小型。しかし魔力は通常種よりも強く、様々なモンスターを召喚することができる。伝説上の生き物とされてきたが、今日ではその伝説の内容を知るものが一人もいない。
entries.en: It is a subspecies of the carbuncle and is smaller. However its magic power is stronger than that of the normal species and it can summon a variety of monsters. It was once considered a fabled creature but today no one knows what the legend is.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ルビーカーバンクル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 悪夢が羊の形をとったもの。逃げる羊を追いかけていくと、いつの間にか悪夢に迷い込んでいるという。もしも…あなたが夢の中でこの羊に会ってしまった場合、「決して目を合わせてはいけない」
entries.en: The nightmare took the form of a sheep. He chases a fleeing sheep but before he knows it he's lost in a nightmare. If...you have met this sheep in your dreams Never make eye contact.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 悪夢の化身
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エウダーナで過剰なまでの魔術改造を施された黒い羊。可視光線を吸収し姿を消すことができる。透明化して敵に近づき生気を奪う。名前が示す通り、まさに外道。
entries.en: A black sheep that has been subjected to an excessive amount of magical modification in Eulderna. It can absorb visible light and disappear. They turn invisible and approach the enemy taking their life away. As the name implies it is truly an outsider.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アストレイ・シープ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 迷える子羊が心身ともに成長し、迷いを乗り越えた姿。その瞳を覗き込めば、固い決意と覚悟に満ち溢れていることがわかるだろう。迷える子羊を優しく見守り、時には導く存在。
entries.en: A lost lamb grows up in mind and body and overcomes his hesitation. If you look into those eyes you can see that they are full of determination and resolve. He is a gentle watcher and sometimes a guide to the lost lamb.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 迷いなき大羊
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 羽の生えた魔力ある蛇神。割と小柄で、５ｍ程度しかない。体から発散している悪臭と毒は疫病神すらも逃げ出す程強烈で、実際に撃退したことがある。毒をもって毒を制すとはこのことだろう。
entries.en: A feathered and magical serpent god. It is relatively small only about 5 meters long. The stench and poison that is emanating from the body is so strong that even the pestilence god runs away and has actually been repelled. This is what it means to conquer poison with poison isn't it?
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: オヤウカムイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 石のように重い声で鳴く蛇。よって鳴蛇。4枚の翼を持ち、水中に巣を作る。水源地を占拠したり雲の中の水分を吸ったりするため、天敵のいない地域ではかんばつが起きる。
entries.en: A snake with a voice as heavy as stone. They have four wings and build a nest in the water. As they occupy water source areas and absorb moisture in the clouds drought occurs in areas without natural enemies.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: メイダ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キッカス原産の蛇でその体長は20ｍ程度にもなる。毒はないが締めつける力が強く、馬や熊が絞殺される。ペットとして連れてこられたものが飼い主を食い殺して脱走し増殖、今日では世界中で家畜を襲っている。
entries.en: This snake is native to Kikkas and its body can be as long as 20 meters. It's not poisonous but it's a tightening force and it strangles horses and bears. Those brought in as pets devour their owners escape and multiply and today attack livestock all over the world.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キッカスパイソン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 地獄の泥から作られたゴーレム。力が強くて普通に危険なのだが、地獄の冷気をまとっており掠っただけでも生気を吸い取られてしまう。あの世に送られた邪悪な魔術士が生み出したとされる。
entries.en: A golem made from the mud of hell. It is powerful and normally dangerous but it is covered with the cold air of hell and even if it is grazed its life will be lost. It is said to have been created by an evil sorcerer sent to the other world.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ネザーマッドゴーレム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 強靭な筋肉の塊。構造・成り立ちから間違いなくゴーレムに分類され、人造人間などとはまた趣が異なる。筋肉の維持に生物を取り込む必要があるのだが、他生物の遺伝子が混ざりすぎると暴走してしまう。
entries.en: A mass of strong muscle. It is definitely categorized as a golem because of its structure and composition and it has a different flavor from an artificial person. They need to take the organism in to maintain their muscles but if the genes of other organisms get mixed in too much they run amok.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マッスルゴーレム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。「辺境の家ほど珍しいお菓子がある」という謎の噂が子供たちの間で広がっており、僻地が逆に人気の模様。かなり本気度の高い仮装で有名。
entries.en: On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. A mysterious rumor is spreading among children that there are more rare treats than a frontier house and it seems that the frontier is becoming more popular in turn. They are famous for their rather serious fancy dress.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 仮装子
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 10月になると仮装して他所のお宅に現れる。怖いもの知らずであり、お菓子のためなら魔物の群れも突っ切り、冒険者の家にも飛び込む。とてつもない執念深さを恐れて居留守を使う家庭も多い。
entries.en: On the 10th month they appear at other people's houses in costume. They are fearless and will fight through a pack of demons for sweets even jumping into the homes of adventurers. There are many families who fear that they will be extremely vindictive.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 遺跡から発見された量産型の恐竜メカ。解析したところ、ジラをモデルとして作られたことが判明した。パワーはあるが格闘戦は苦手で、ホバー能力を用いて距離を取り、砲撃戦を展開する。
entries.en: A mass-produced dinosaur mecha that was discovered in the ruins. Analysis revealed that it was built with Zilla as a model. He has power but is not good at fighting and uses his hover ability to gain distance and engage in gunfights.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: メカジラ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 数十ｍサイズの霧状の怪物。肉食性であり、普段は雲に擬態して船などを襲っている。捕食の際には体の一部を固体化させ、口などの器官を作り出す。
entries.en: A foggy monster several tens of meters in size. It is carnivorous and usually mimics a cloud to attack ships. During predation it solidifies parts of its body and produces organs such as its mouth.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クラウドビースト
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 百ｍ前後もの体長を持つ巨大で細長い生物。不可視の存在。旺盛な食欲で大地を食らい、他の星を死滅させたこともある。イルヴァではギガモールという天敵がおり、たまらず地上へ逃げてくることが多い。
entries.en: A huge slender creature with a body length of around one hundred meters. An invisible presence. It has devoured the earth with its voracious appetite and has even killed other stars. In Irva there is a natural enemy called Gigamor and it often runs away to the ground in desperation.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ドール
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。鬼の中でも上位の存在。自らでも抑えきれないほどの高い魔力を持ち、体から漏れる魔力が「輝き」を放つ。
entries.en: They are originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. It is a high ranking among the demons. It possesses a high level of magical power that is uncontrollable even by itself and the magical power leaking from its body gives off a glow.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 輝鬼
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。クールで冷静だが荒々しい衝動を秘めている。力と技をあわせ持ち、刃物の扱いに長け、邪魔するものを「切裂き」排除する。
entries.en: They are originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. They're cool and calm but they have wild impulses. They possess a combination of strength and skill and are skilled with blades and can cut through anything that gets in their way.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 切裂鬼
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神、悪魔、地霊などの側面を持つ妖怪だが元々は人間。荒々しい性格で非常に力も強く、邪魔するものを粉々に「砕き」排除する。人と意気投合し、親しくなることもある。
entries.en: They were originally human though they have aspects such as gods demons and earth spirits. They have a rugged personality and are extremely powerful shattering and eliminating anything that gets in their way. It is possible to hit it off with them and get to know them well.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 砕鬼
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: より戦闘に特化したエイリアン。過去に寄生した生物の遺伝子を取り込んでおり、知能、身体能力ともに普通のエイリアンとは比べ物にならない。酸性の粘液を積極的に武器として用いる。
entries.en: An alien that specializes more in combat. It has taken in the genes of a parasitic organism from the past and its intelligence and physical abilities are beyond those of ordinary aliens. It actively uses acidic mucus as a weapon.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: バトルエイリアン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 宇宙のテクノロジーで戦闘用に強化された蟻のような巨大生物。全体的に能力が上昇しているが、甲殻と酸噴出力の強化が著しい。色のせいでステルス性能は下がっているが。
entries.en: An ant-like behemoth that has been enhanced for combat by space technology. Overall ability has been increased with significant enhancements to the shell and acid eruption power. The stealth performance is down though due to the color.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 戦甲殻虫
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 宇宙のテクノロジーで強化された蜘蛛のような巨大生物。鋼のようなボディと驚異的な跳躍力を持つ。酸を練り混ぜた糸を吐いているが、イルヴァの大気とは相性が悪く、糸が分解され酸だけが飛び散ってしまう。
entries.en: A spider-like behemoth enhanced by space technology. It has a steel-like body and tremendous jumping power. It spits out a thread of kneaded acid but it is incompatible with Irva's atmosphere so the thread breaks down and only the acid splashes out.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鋼体凶虫
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 超重力崩壊に巻き込まれた一匹のジラ。不安定な異空間を漂ううちにその身体は様々なものを取り込んで再構成された。エネルギーを吸収し、体内の結晶から自分の複製体を生み出していく。
entries.en: A lone zilla caught in a hypergravity collapse. As it drifted through the unstable space its body took in various things and reconfigured itself. It absorbs energy and creates a duplicate of itself from the crystals in its body.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: スペースジラ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 闇にまぎれて獲物を狙う、雀の妖怪。対象を追跡し、視力を奪い襲い掛かる。普通の雀と違って夜行性だが、夜更かしならぬ朝更かしして起きている個体も少なくないので油断してはいけない。
entries.en: A sparrow demon that seeks its prey under the cover of darkness. It tracks the target takes away their sight and attacks them. Unlike the common sparrow it is nocturnal although there are many individuals who stay up late in the morning so don't let your guard down.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 闇夜雀
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 国家機密から個人の性癖まで幅広くカバーする情報屋。幾度となく消されそうになっているが、修羅場をくぐり抜けていく内に尋常じゃないほど強くなった。関係者の弱みを完全掌握した現在は手を出されていない。
entries.en: An informant who covers a wide range of topics from state secrets to personal proclivities. She has been almost killed many times but she has become extremely strong as she has gone through the rounds. The weaknesses of those involved have been fully seized and she is now untouched.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 情報魔の『メルゼッタ』
