entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 破壊衝動の塊のような悪魔。破壊の神が再生のために破壊を行うのに対し、こちらは形あるものを壊すのが快感なだけらしい。特に美しい物を無惨なまでに粉々にするのが好き。
entries.en: A demon like a mass of destructive impulses. It seems that the God of Creation destroys for the sake of rebirth while the God of Destruction only feels pleasure in destroying tangible things. He especially likes to ruthlessly shatter beautiful things.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 破壊の悪魔『ラジャシェ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鳥の特徴を一部備えており、さらに耳のようなものもあるためこの名で呼ばれる。過去の文献には喋り方が彼らと酷似している機械の記述があり、遥か昔から偵察機械を送り込んでいたのではないかと噂される。
entries.en: It is called by this name because it has some of the characteristics of a bird plus some of the ears. There is a description of a machine that speaks very similarly to them in the past and it is rumored that a reconnaissance machine was sent in from long ago.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 宇宙ミミズク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鋼のように鍛え上げられたすさまじい筋肉を誇る黒い牛人。そこら辺のミノタウロスとは比較にならないほどのパワーファイターだが足元がお留守で、脛やら膝やらを怪我して戦闘不能になることも。
entries.en: A black ox-man boasting tremendous muscles that are built like steel. He is a power fighter in comparison to the Minotaur but he is not always on his feet and he is sometimes unable to fight due to injuries to his shins and knees.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鋼の猛牛
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 第一期文明さえ生まれる遥か昔から、再生・分裂を繰り返して生きてきた偉大なる大先輩。悠久の時を過ごす内に魔力を蓄えて進化を遂げ、空中での活動も可能になった。実はコラーゲンたっぷりで美容にいい。
entries.en: A great great elder who has lived through repeated rebirth and division since long before even the first civilization was born. As it spent its eternity it accumulated magical power and evolved allowing it to operate in the air. In fact it is full of collagen and good for your beauty.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クラーゲン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 宇宙の海をまたにかける伝説の勇者鮫の子孫。宇宙でも空でも海でも活動できる掟破りの海賊野郎。黄金の地とされる、先祖の生まれ故郷を探すうちにイルヴァに辿りついた。
entries.en: A descendant of the legendary brave shark that ventured across the seas of space. He's a law-breaking pirate who can operate in space in the air and at sea. While searching for his ancestral birthplace which is said to be the land of gold he found himself in Irva.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キャプテンシャーク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 精霊が鮫を象って実体化した存在。ネバーギブアップの精神を持ち粘り強いが、戦闘力に関してはそこまで高くない。一応、鼻先はチタンよりも硬く、鋭い歯は大岩も噛み砕くらしい。
entries.en: A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a shark. It has the spirit of never-give-up and is tenacious but its combat power is not that high. Apparently the tip of its nose is harder than titanium and its sharp teeth can chew through even large rocks.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 怒涛の鮫
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 仲間との連携を基本戦術とする鮫。最前線で直接攻撃する仲間たちが傷ついていくのを嫌というほど目にしており、自責の念から自分自身も悪夢でよくうなされている。
entries.en: A shark whose basic tactics are to cooperate with his companions. He has seen his comrades who attack directly on the front lines get hurt so badly that he often has nightmares himself because of his own remorse.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ナイトメアシャーク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 妄人はワンニンと読む。邪気に侵され半分冷蔵庫になってしまった人間。妄想し続けないと自我を失い完全に冷蔵庫になってしまう状態にある。属性攻撃を一部吸収し、即座に射出することができる。
entries.en: A person who has been invaded by evil spirits and has become half a refrigerator. It is in a state where if it does not continue to fantasize it will lose its ego and become a complete fridge. It absorbs some of the attribute attacks and can be immediately ejected.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 超級妄人
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: メシェーラの特性を最大限に引き出せるよう人体改造と投薬を行った結果、適合できずに変異してしまった。新鮮な肉体がベースになっているためか、レミード遺跡のオリジナルメシェーラよりもよっぽど強い。
entries.en: As a result of human modification and medication to get the best out of Meshera's characteristics she was unable to adapt and mutated. Perhaps because it's based on fresh flesh it's much stronger than the original Meshera in the Rehmido Ruins.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 実験台
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ほぼ全ての状態異常と属性が効かない巨人。その真の力は神に匹敵すると言われるが、いつも寝ており闘うところを見るのは困難。数少ない戦闘目撃証言によると寝ぼけて武器を使わず素手で殴っていたらしい。
entries.en: A giant with almost all health problems and no attributes. It is said that his true power is comparable to that of a god but he is always sleeping and it is difficult to see him fight. According to the few witness accounts of the battle he was sleepy and struck with his bare hands without using a weapon.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 眠れる巨人
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 見た目はただの大型の蝶にしか見えないが、未来に大きく干渉する力を秘めている。その羽ばたきは極めて微小なものだが、巡り巡って大嵐を起こす決定的な要因にもなり得るのだとか。
entries.en: It may look like just a large butterfly but it has the power to interfere with the future. The fluttering of the wings is extremely minute but it can be a decisive factor in causing a huge storm.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エフェクトバタフライ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 過去の文明で生み出された生体兵器の子孫。鱗粉のように見えるものは物質を作り変える性質を持っており、攻撃に使えば体を蝕む毒、防御に使えば薬となる。先祖はもっと強大で、文明をひとつ滅ぼしたらしい。
entries.en: The descendants of biological weapons produced by past civilizations. What appears to be scales has the ability to alter its property becoming a poison to consume the body when used for offense and a medicine when used for defense. Apparently their ancestors were more powerful and destroyed one civilization.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 月光蝶
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 見た目はただの大型の蝶にしか見えないが、実は訓練されたアサシン。無害な蝶のように舞い寄り、蜂のように刺す。見た目に騙されてはいけないのだ。
entries.en: Although it looks like just a large butterfly it is actually a trained assassin. It flutters like a harmless butterfly and stings like a bee. Don't be fooled by appearances.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 幻蝶の刺客
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 探偵に化けて街に紛れ込む人狼。仲間の狼を処刑されないように、偽の証言で人々を振り回す。化けている間はつい吠えてしまわないように我慢しているのでストレスが溜まるらしい。
entries.en: A werewolf disguised as a detective blends in with the city. They sway people with false testimony to keep their fellow wolves from being executed. They seem to be under a lot of stress because they try not to bark while they are disguised.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人狼探偵
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 本能により事件の匂いを嗅ぎつける。事件が起きると決まって姿を現すため、何も悪くないのに人々から厄病神扱いされることも多い。そのことで精神を病み、とち狂って狼と友達になろうとする者もいる。
entries.en: Instinctively he smells an incident. Because he always appears when an incident occurs he is often regarded by people as a god of disaster even though he has done nothing wrong. Some of them become mentally ill from this and try to make friends with wolves due to their madness.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 精霊が獅子を象って実体化した存在。炎の力を纏って走る赤い獅子。五感を研ぎ澄ますことで眠れる力が開き、巨大化するとかしないとか。鋭い爪が武器。
entries.en: A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a lion. A red lion running with the power of the flame. Perhaps by sharpening the five senses the power to sleep will open up and it will become huge or something. Sharp claws are their weapon.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 灼熱の獅子
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 精霊が狼を象って実体化した存在。サーベルと光線銃を用いて戦う俊敏な狼。強いことは確かなのだが、どこかズレているところがある。銀色というより光る灰色に見えるがきっと気のせいだろう。
entries.en: A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of a wolf. An agile wolf who fights with a saber and a ray gun. They are strong for sure but there is something off about them. It appears to be a shiny gray rather than a silvery color but maybe it's just my imagination.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 閃烈の銀狼
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 外法によってゾンビのような体になってしまった哀れな女性。さらに何者かの呪いによって著しく強化されている。感情は残っており、座り込み嘆き悲しんでいるところをよく目撃される。なお、近づくと爪で攻撃される。
entries.en: A poor woman who has been turned into a zombie-like entity by foreign laws. In addition it is significantly enhanced by the curse of some one. Their emotions remain and they are often seen sitting and grieving. It will attack with its claws if approached.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 慟哭のウィッチ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 呪いによって、いつまでも狂ったように踊り続ける死者。盆踊りが得意らしいが、生者にはただの乱痴気騒ぎにしか見えない。それでも死者たちには概ね好評のようだ。
entries.en: The dead dance like mad forever by a curse. Apparently they are really good at bon-dancing but to the living it looks like nothing more than an orgy. Still it seems to have been generally well received by the dead.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ネクロダンサー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 死霊となった槍使い。元はただの衛兵だったが命を落とした際に呪いをかけられ生まれ変わった。知性が無く、割と力任せに突き刺すだけなので「鈍器などのほうが向いているのでは？」とよく言われる。
entries.en: A spearman who has become a spirit of death. It was once just a guard but when it lost its life it was cursed and reborn. It has no intelligence and only stabs at you with force perhaps a blunt instrument would be better suited.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ネクロランサー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 伝承に残るばかりの古代鳥と同じ姿、同じ名前を持つ謎の存在。主な生息地も、どこから来てどこへ行くのかも不明。ちなみに、やってきたコウノトリを追跡するのは昔からタブーとされている。
entries.en: A mysterious being with the same appearance and name as an ancient bird that has only just been preserved in lore. Their primary habitat and where they come from and where they go are unknown. Incidentally it has long been taboo to pursue the storks that visit you.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 『コウノトリさん』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ザナンの現場叩き上げの兵士。歴戦のつわものだが士官学校を出ておらず軍での地位も名声も低い。何も知らされずに危険な任務に駆り出されることも多い。
entries.en: Zanan's field-raised soldier. He is a war veteran but he has not graduated from officer's school and has a low rank and fame in the military. They are often sent out on dangerous missions without being informed.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ザナン重装兵
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 頭に傷を負った少年。自分の名前以外を忘れた状態でネレスと共に倒れていた。礼儀正しく物腰も柔らかであり、かなり良好な家庭で育ったのではないかと言われているが真相は不明。
entries.en: A boy with a head injury. He collapsed with Neres in a state where he had forgotten everything but his own name. He is polite and soft-spoken and it is said that he may have grown up in a very good family but the truth is unknown.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 記憶喪失の『リューツェ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 子供の姿をしているが身体能力がやたらと高く、さらに戦闘慣れしている。記憶喪失だが、肝心なところが思い出せないだけで色々と断片は残っているのだとか。イルヴァの風景には全く見覚えが無いらしい。
entries.en: Although she has the appearance of a child her physical abilities are extremely high and she is used to fighting. She has amnesia she just can't remember the important parts but there are many fragments left. Apparently she isn't at all familiar with the landscape of Irva.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 記憶喪失の『ネレス』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 元は木こりだったが身に覚えのない借金を押し付けられて破産し、怪しい男にザナン軍の研究施設へと拉致された。生体兵器への改造手術および劇薬投与に耐え、メシェーラの制御能力を得た後、脱走に成功。
entries.en: He used to be a lumberjack but when he was forced into a debt he didn't recognize he went bankrupt and was abducted by a suspicious man to a research facility in Zanan's army. After enduring a bio-weapon modification surgery and the administration of heavy drugs he successfully escaped after gaining control of Meshera.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 改造人間『エユル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 観光の便宜を図るツアープランナー。必要とあらば未開の地にも超音速で赴くし、神とだって交渉する。足の速さと段取りの早さが自慢だが、手が出るのはもっと早い。リアという名前の妹がいる。
entries.en: A tour planner who works for the convenience of tourism. When necessary she travels at supersonic speed to the wilderness and even negotiates with gods. She prides herself on being quick on her feet and quick to set up things but she is even quicker to get her hands on things. She has a sister named Leah.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: プランナーの『フロン』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 子供の頃、家出中に出会った異星の剣士と友人になり剣の腕を磨いたらしい。何十年経っても忘れないようにと、友の愛剣に似せたデザインの長剣を携帯している。
entries.en: When he was a child he became friends with an alien swordsman he met while running away from home and honed his sword skills. He carries a long sword with a design similar to his friend's beloved sword so that he won't forget it even after decades.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 宇宙を望む『クロヤ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ミニチュアサイズのゴーレム。それでも人間と同じくらいの大きさだが。おっとりとした性格のものが多く、気がつくと頭に小鳥などが止まっていたりする。
entries.en: A miniature size golem. It's still about the same size as a human though. Many of them have a calm personality and sometimes a small bird is perched on their head before they notice.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ちびウッドゴーレム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ミニチュアサイズのゴーレム。それでも人間と同じくらいの大きさだが。ぶっきらぼうで石頭な性格だが、仕事を一心不乱に行う職人肌のものが多い。
entries.en: A miniature size golem. It's still about the same size as a human though. It's a blunt and stubborn individual but there are many craftsmen who devote themselves to their work.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ちびストーンゴーレム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クトゥグアと互角の力を持つ炎の神。次元の扉の影に潜み、クトゥグアが召喚される際に紛れて現れる。焼くことと食べることしか頭になく、非常に危険な存在。
entries.en: A fire god with power equal to that of Cthugha. It lurks in the shadows of the dimensional door and appears among the cthughas when they are summoned. They are very dangerous with only burning and consuming in their minds.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 貪食の炎環
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 異星からやってきた炎の神。人間とは別に敵対しているわけではなく、場合によっては意思疎通も可能。だが戦闘となれば森だろうが街だろうがナイアーラトテップだろうが焼き尽くすのでやっぱり危険。
entries.en: A fire god from a different world. They are not antagonistic to humans and can communicate with them in some cases. But when it comes to battle the forest the city and the nyarlathotep will burn to the ground.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クトゥグア
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 海の支配者として崇拝されていた神だが、他の海神たちとの勢力争いに敗北。その力の欠片は蟹の営巣地に降り注ぎ蟹を操る魔物に転生した。その経緯から、神の頃から蟹しか操れなかったとよく勘違いされる。
entries.en: A god who was worshipped as the ruler of the sea was defeated in a power struggle with the other sea gods. A piece of the power fell on the crab's nesting grounds and transformed into a crab-controlling demon. Because of this it is often mistakenly assumed that he has only been able to control crabs since he was a deity.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: バサタン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 漆黒の立方体。自律型の機械であるとされるが内部構造は完全に不明。熱線や破壊光線を出すほか、周囲に撹乱用の霧を発生させる機能を持つ。
entries.en: A jet-black cube. It is said to be an autonomous machine but its internal structure is completely unknown. In addition to emitting heat and destructive rays it also has the ability to create a disturbing fog around it.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ブラックボックス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 地下遺跡から発見された謎の機械。凄まじい耐久性を持っているため、これは本来鈍器であり電子部品は何らかの理由で後から組み込まれたのでないかという学説まで出ている。
entries.en: A mysterious machine discovered in the underground ruins. Because of its tremendous durability there is even a theory that it was originally a blunt instrument and the electronic components were built in later for some reason.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: Ｇキューブ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 金属と宝石を司る中級神にして、大地の神の姉。大地の神の力を勝手に使って自分をモデルとした黄金の騎士を作り、騎士団を率いている。その豪胆さには大地の神も苦笑いするという。
entries.en: She is mid-level god of metals and gems and the sister of the earth god. Using the power of the God of the Earth at her disposal she created a golden knight modeled after herself to lead the Order. It is said that the god of the earth laughs at her boldness.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 《剛石のウリカグアル》
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 歌って踊れて楽器も使える中級神。元は幻の鳥に過ぎなかったが、富の女神に音楽センスを高く評価され力を分け与えられた。ノってくるとトランス状態になり性格が変わる。白金ガチョウのモデルとされる。
entries.en: A mid-level god who can sing dance and use musical instruments. Originally a mere phantom bird she was given a share of power by the goddess of wealth who appreciated her musical sense. When she starts singing she goes into a trance and her personality changes. It is believed to be the model for the white gold goose.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 《歌踊のカラヴィカ》
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人間を食料にしようとしている異星人。餌にした人間に擬態し、潜伏を行う。高い科学力と魔力を持つが思い込みが激しく、簡単に相手を信用してしまう。口のあたりから伸びている触手部分が弱点。
entries.en: The aliens are trying to use humans as food. It mimics the humans it feeds and hides. They have high scientific and magical powers but they are very naive and will easily put their trust in others. The tentacles extending from the mouth are the weak point.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: スンバラリア星人
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 強い魔力と知性を持った狐。昔は滅びた村の周囲にひっそりと生息していたが最近は孤独に耐えられず、人間に化けて街に紛れ込み生活している。同じく紛れ込んでいる人狼を邪魔に思っている。
entries.en: A fox with strong magic and intelligence. They used to live quietly around a ruined village but these days they can't stand the solitude so they disguise themselves as humans and live among the city. They think that the werewolves who are also among them are in the way.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 妖狐
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 深海で眠っていた九頭竜。半覚醒状態で本来の力は出せていないが強力な精神干渉能力と不死性を持つ。その正体は太古に飛来した宇宙生物で、第一期文明の覇権争いにも参加していた。ツァトゥグァとは親戚。
entries.en: The nine head dragon was asleep in the deep sea. In his half-awakened state he does not have his original powers but he does have a powerful mental interference ability and immortality. Its true identity is a space creature that flew in from time immemorial and participated in the struggle for supremacy of the first civilization. He is related to Tsathoggua.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 『目覚めし九頭竜』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 頑張り屋さんな掃除ロボ。掃除に熱中するあまり迷子になったり、思い詰めて家出したりすることもあるので飼育環境には注意。動物好きで、猫などをおんぶしようとする習性がある。
entries.en: A cleaning robot who is a hard worker. They may get lost in the heat of cleaning or run away from home so be careful of the environment in which they are kept. It is a lover of animals and has a habit of trying to carry a cat on its back.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 清掃機械
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 運搬作業や簡単な点検を担当する人型マシン。戦闘用ではないが作業用アームで殴られれば一般人は昏倒するだろう。特殊作業機械に対して劣等感を抱いている。
entries.en: A humanoid machine that is in charge of carrying out operations and simple inspections. It's not combat-grade but if hit with a working arm a civilian would be knocked out. They feel inadequate to the special work equipment.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 作業機械
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 精密作業や整備改造を担当する人型マシン。戦闘用ではないので本来は装甲はおろか武器も持たないのだが、アンドロイドを羨んで自分自身を改造。簡単な武器なら扱えるようになっている。
entries.en: A humanoid machine in charge of precision work and maintenance and modification. It has no armor or weapons because it is not designed for combat but it has modified itself to be the envy of androids. It can handle simple weapons.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 特殊作業機械
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 乗り物を司る中級神。乗り物の進歩に伴って身体を機械化した。神々の大戦時には自ら建造した戦艦を駆り機械の神と共闘した。後にアンドロイドのモデルとなる。
entries.en: An mid-level god who governs the vehicles. The body was mechanized as the vehicle progressed. During the Great War of the Gods he fought alongside the machine gods in battleships he had built himself. It later became a model for the android.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 《鉄騎のガルジエム》
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 青き戦場の狼。群れを形成し格上の相手でも連携で仕留める。群れから外れた個体は大抵強力な敵との戦闘で深手を負わされ死ぬのだが、稀に単独で多くの敵を次々薙ぎ倒すような活躍を見せるものもいる。
entries.en: Blue Wolf of the Battlefield. They form a pack and work together to finish off even the best opponents. Individuals who stray from the pack are usually deeply wounded and die in battle with powerful enemies but in rare cases they are able to mow down many enemies one after another on their own.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: コマンドーウルフ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 市民そっくりに化ける食人オオカミ。こっそり街や村に紛れ込んで夜な夜な市民を襲う。会話や態度も模倣する演技派。普通の人間では判別困難だが、熟練の冒険者となると体捌きや所持品で判別できるようだ。
entries.en: A cannibal wolf that disguises itself as a citizen. They sneak into towns and villages and attack citizens night after night. An actor who also imitates conversation and attitude. It's difficult for normal humans to tell the difference but skilled adventurers seem to be able to tell by their body language and possessions.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 人狼
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 上位の神であったが癒しの女神を守り通すと決め、女神の下に降った。その献身ぶりを認められ防衛者のモデルとなったまではよかったが、過保護ぶりと生真面目さが原因で最近はちょっと鬱陶しく思われている。
entries.en: He was a superior god but he decided to protect the goddess of healing and he was brought under the goddess. He was once a model defender for his dedication but his overprotection and earnestness have made him a bit of a pain in the ass lately.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 《守護のロヴィト》
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 実戦に投入されることのなかったイェルスード２号機を改修した新型決戦兵器。表向きは性能強化と武装変更ということになっているが、一度没になった合体機構が開発主任の独断で秘密裏に復元されている。
entries.en: A new type of decisive weapon that is a modified version of the Yerleswood prototype which was never used in actual battle. On the surface it's supposed to be a performance enhancement and armament change but the merging mechanism which once disappeared has been restored in secret by the chief developer's discretion.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 『ネオ・イェルスード』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鬼面を被った謎の忍者。外法で身体を操られており、意識のあるまま戦わされている。分身や身代わりはもちろんのこと、我流の忍術も身に着けており、その身一つで浮遊し、霧を操る。
entries.en: A mysterious ninja wearing a demon mask. His body is manipulated by the Outer Law and he is forced to fight back while he is conscious. In addition to his alter ego and body-substitution he also wields his own ninjutsu which allows him to levitate and control the fog.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鬼面の忍者『藍影』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 全てを焼き尽くす最強最後のファントム。格闘戦もお手の物で、その長い腕から繰り出される攻撃は強烈。空間を歪曲させて移動し、獲物を執拗に追いかける。
entries.en: The strongest final phantom that burns everything down. Its long arms give off a strong attack and it can fight in combat as well. It distorts and moves through space relentlessly chasing its prey.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ラストファントム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 古の神々の争いの中、切り落とされた神の腕。本体と分断されてなお戦意は残っており、敵めがけてすごい勢いで飛んでいく。凄まじい速度で放たれる拳撃を全て躱すのは至難の業だ。
entries.en: The hand of the god that was cut off in the strife of the old gods. Even though it is separated from the main body it still has the will to fight and it flies at the enemy with great speed. It would be extremely difficult to dodge all the fist blows that were unleashed at great speed.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ゴッドハンド
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヤギという生物の絶滅後、その代用として何度も身代わりにされてきた羊。しかし、抵抗し逃げ出した強者も存在した。彼らは逃げた先で武装し、今日も生き残るために脅威から逃げ続けるのだ。
entries.en: Since the extinction of the goat creature the sheep have been sacrificed many times as a substitute for it. However there were some strong individuals who resisted and ran away. They took up arms wherever they fled and today they continue to run from threats to survive.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: Ｅ・スケープゴート
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 原初の神の炎から生まれた伝説の火炎竜。普段は魔力を鎧状にして熱の吸収放出を抑えているが、傷を負うとそれが保てなくなり熱暴走を起こす。鎧が崩壊すると魔力が炎に混ざり、急激に炎の温度が上昇する。
entries.en: A legendary flame dragon born from the flames of the primordial god. Normally it uses magical power as an armor to suppress the absorption and release of heat but when it is injured it is unable to hold on and goes into heat rage. As the armor disintegrated the magical power mixed with the flames causing the temperature of the flames to rise rapidly.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 創炎竜『ヴァンセスダ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 充分な熱を得られる環境で育った火炎竜。その辺で普通に育った個体とは発する熱が段違いで、黄色い炎を身に纏う。炎周辺が千度前後もある一方で体内温度が４０度もないのは生来の火炎耐性によるものだ。
entries.en: A flaming dragon that grew up in an environment where it could get enough heat. It emits different heat from the individual that grew up in the area and clad in a yellow flame. The fact that the temperature inside the body is not 40 degrees while the temperature around the flame is around 1000 degrees is due to innate flame tolerance.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 黄炎竜
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。その瞳には人間から吸い取ったマナが無秩序に混ざり込んでおり、まさしく混沌の瞳と言える。
entries.en: The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. The mana sucked from the human is mixed in with the chaos in the eyes and it can truly be said to be the eyes of chaos.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カオス・シャーマン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。肉体と共に取り込んだ剣を一時的に魔剣化しており、獲物の血を啜らせる。その太刀筋は滅茶苦茶で、読むことは難しい。
entries.en: The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. The sword he has taken in with his body is temporarily transformed into a magical sword making him shed the blood of his prey. Its boldness is so messed up that it is difficult to read.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カオス・ブレーダー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。肉体と共に取り込んだクロスボウを左腕に融合させている。ハンターとしての狩りのセンスは健在。
entries.en: The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. He fuses his left arm with a crossbow that he has taken in along with his body. As a hunter his hunting sense is strong.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カオス・ハンター
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: その巨体と馬鹿力から銀熊の異名を持つが、幼い頃から体格とやや毛深いことがコンプレックスであり自分の異名を嫌っている。熊呼ばわりされるのが嫌で人の話を聞かない。力だけでなく母性本能も人一倍強い。
entries.en: She is known as a silver bear because of her huge body and stupendous strength but since she was a child she has had a complex about her physique and hairiness and hates her nickname. She doesn't listen to people because she doesn't like being called a bear. She has not only strength but also a maternal instinct that is much stronger than most people.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: メイルーンの銀熊『マルカ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘の民の中でも情報通で外との架け橋。今でこそ髭はファッション扱いで言葉遣いも多様だが、彼らが外の世界の情報を流布させなければ、今でも女子供全員髭を生やし老人言葉なのが常識だっただろう。
entries.en: Even among the hillfolk he is a well-informed person and a bridge to the outside world. Nowadays beards are treated as a fashion and language is diverse but if they hadn't let the outside world influence them it would still be commonplace for all women and children to grow beards and use the old language.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘の識者
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 遠い昔に集落を去った丘の民たちの子孫。外の世界に出て何世代も生活してきたためか、本来の丘の民たちよりも開放的で挑戦的な性格をしている。何者かに召喚され、先祖ゆかりの地へたどり着いた。
entries.en: The descendants of the hillfolk who left the settlement in the distant past. Perhaps because she has lived in the outside world for generations she has a more open and challenging personality than the original hillfolk. She was summoned by someone and arrived at a place related to her ancestors.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 異邦の研鑽者『イルマ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘長の孫娘。祖父をあまり快く思っていない。祖父の自伝を読まされたり自慢話を聞かされたりする過程で伝統技法の要点を知った。目利きの才能が祖父以上にあるのだが、それ以前に職人になる気がない。
entries.en: Granddaughter of the hill chief. She doesn't take much pleasure in her grandfather. In the process of reading her grandfather's autobiography and listening to him brag about it she learned the gist of the traditional technique. She has more talent as a connoisseur than her grandfather but before that she has no desire to become a craftsman.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 星見の『サリム』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘の民を仕切る長。昔は集落の中でも一番の名工で多くの弟子がいたが、弟子が自分を超えるのを恐れて難癖をつけ全員破門。職人として生きる自信を奪い、結果として若い民の伝統工芸離れを促進した。
entries.en: He is the chief in charge of the hill people. In the past he was the best craftsman in the village and had many pupils but all of them were excommunicated because he was afraid that his pupils would surpass him. It deprived them of the confidence to live as artisans and as a result it encouraged the young people to leave traditional crafts.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘長の『ダイン』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘の近辺で収集してきた物を元に家具やら生活雑貨、家屋を作ったり、畑で作物を育てたりして仲間内で細々と取引している。よそ者が来ると外貨獲得のため嬉々として売りつける。
entries.en: They make furniture household items and houses from the things they've collected near the hill and grow crops in the fields. When strangers arrive they gleefully sell them to get foreign currency.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 店主
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: まだ子供だが見た目は大人とほとんど変わらない。喋り方もほぼ同じだが丘の民の間では服装や雰囲気で区別できるらしい。職人の厳しさと苦しさを子供ながらに予見しており、その道を選ぼうとはしない。
entries.en: He's still a child but he looks almost the same as an adult. The way they speak is almost the same but among the hillfolk they can be distinguished by their clothes and atmosphere. Even as a child he foresees the harshness and pain of the craftsman and he does not choose to follow that path.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘の子
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘の近辺を生活圏とし、遠出することはあまりない。先祖代々、家や採取場、道具などを受け継いでおり、土地に愛着がある。客としてのよそ者には友好的だが、よそ者の移住は認めようとしない。
entries.en: They live near the hills and don't travel very far. They have inherited their homes quarries and tools from their ancestors and are attached to the land. They are friendly to strangers as guests but are reluctant to allow strangers to settle in.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 丘の民
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 戦闘用に品種改良され金色のオーラを纏うようになったキウイ。品種改良の影響で肉が甘く、黄色くなっている。その神々しさから少数の人々に崇められている。
entries.en: A kiwi that has been bred for combat use and has come to wear a golden aura. Due to the breeding process the flesh is sweeter and more yellow. It is revered by a small number of people because of its godliness.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ゴールドキウイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 飛べない鳥。好奇心から他の動物に近づいていくほど警戒心が薄いが、脚力はものすごい。キーウイー、という珍しい鳴き声のせいであまりに安直な名前をつけられた。
entries.en: A bird that can't fly. The closer they get to other animals out of curiosity the less alert they are but they have tremendous leg power. It was given an overly cheesy name because of its unusual cry of kee-wee.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: キウイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 通称、死を告げる凶星。身体こそ小さいが生き抜こうとする強い意志を持ち、肉体の限界を突破するたびに生命の炎は輝きを増していく。
entries.en: Also known as the Death Star. Although his body is small he has a strong will to survive and every time he breaks through the limits of his body the flame of life becomes more brilliant.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: デススター
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 森にすむ小動物で、樹上からの射撃を得意とする。放たれる矢はまるで流れ星のよう。矢が着弾するまでに願い事をすると叶うとか叶わないとか。
entries.en: He is a small animal that lives in the forest and is an expert at shooting from the tree tops. The arrow is like a shooting star. They say that if you make a wish before the arrow lands it will come true ... or not.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: シューティングスター
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 大きな頬袋を持つネズミ。丸っこくて愛らしい姿が人気だが、猫に対する恐怖を乗り越えるため武装しており、戦闘力が普通のネズミと段違い。口内に暗器を隠し持っていることがある。
entries.en: A mouse with a large cheek pouch. They are popular for their round adorable appearance and are armored to overcome their fear of cats so their fighting power is unmatched by ordinary rats. They sometimes carry a dark device in their mouths.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ハムスター
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 宇宙からやってきた作業用の機械生命体。起動時期こそ最近だが、製造された時期は遥か昔のようだ。一度廃棄されており、廃棄区画から抜け出すのには数年を要した。
entries.en: A working mechanical life form from outer space. It seems to have been manufactured a long time ago although it started up recently. Once discarded it took several years to get out of the disposal area.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 脱走機械『ガージンド』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 化身の黒猫のモデルとなった、不幸を司る女神。幸運の女神と神々の大戦時に戦い、激戦の果てにその力の大半を相殺されたが、勝ったのは自分だと信じてやまない。
entries.en: The goddess of misfortune who is the model for the Black Cat. She fought during the Great War among the gods and the Goddess of Fortune and though the fierce battle stripped most of her power she still believes she was the one who won.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 《不幸のシナア》
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 元は天使だったのだが、風の女神に服従と忠誠を誓い、力を分け与えられて神となった。日焼けや砂まみれになるのを嫌がって、ずっと引きこもっている。黒天使のモデルとなった。
entries.en: Originally an angel she swore obedience and allegiance to the goddess of the wind and was given power to become a deity. She doesn't want to get sunburned or covered in sand so she stays withdrawn all the time. She became the model for the Black Angel.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 《砂嵐のラシエル》
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 溶岩でできたゴーレム。魔力によって膨大な熱量を維持している。高熱攻撃はエネルギーの消費が大きいため使いたがらない。内部に溜まっている水蒸気やガスを爆発させての攻撃が得意。
entries.en: A golem made of lava. It maintains an enormous amount of heat through its magic. They don't want to use high heat attacks because they consume a lot of energy. It is good at attacking by exploding steam and gas inside.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ラーヴァゴーレム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 収穫の神の生命輪廻を司る側面より生まれた中級神。生命の存在記録を管理する者で、定められていない死を迎えた者を蘇生して送り返している。妖精さんのモデルともなった。
entries.en: A mid-level deity born from the aspect of the god of harvest who presides over the cycle of life and samsara. He is the custodian of the record of the existence of life resuscitating and sending back those who have met an unspecified death. He also became a model for the fairies.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 《永遠のネヘルタード》
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 地獄のような暑さの火口に生育し、その熱気に揺れる一輪の花。高熱がエネルギー源で、余剰熱は火炎魔法として排出する。さすがに溶岩を浴びると焼けるようだ。
entries.en: A single flower that grows in the crater of hellish heat and sways in the heat of it. High heat is the source of energy and the excess heat is expelled as flame magic. As expected it seems to burn when exposed to lava.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: インフェルノフラワー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鉱物を飲みこんで体内で弾丸を生成し、口から吐き出す。それだけなら大したことはないのだが、噛みついた状態で接射してくることもあるので接近するのは危険。
entries.en: It swallows the minerals produces bullets in its body and spits them out of its mouth. If that's all it's no big deal but it's dangerous to approach them because they may shoot at you while biting you.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: バレットワーム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 主に砂地に生息する砂虫だが、地面に潜っている間に迷子になってしまい、場違いな場所に顔を出してしまうことがある。図体の割に動きが俊敏で、一瞬で穴に潜り一瞬で顔を出す。
entries.en: They are mainly sand bugs that live in sandy areas but they can get lost while burrowing on the ground and show their faces in out-of-place places. They move quickly for their size diving into a hole in an instant and coming out of it in an instant.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: サンドワーム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 手が付けられないほどに狂暴な巨大イノシシ。美食家で美味しい作物ばかりを狙うため、こいつが畑にやってきたことを自慢する農家もいたりする。
entries.en: A giant wild boar so frenzied that it can't be touched. Some farmers are proud of the fact that this guy has come to their fields because gourmets aim for only delicious crops.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: デストロイノシシ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 巨大な野獣。特殊な力は何も持っていないが、助走をつけてからの突進が十分すぎる威力なのだ。突進力だけかと思いきや、機敏で小回りが利く。
entries.en: A giant beast. He has no special powers but his rush after he puts on his main run is more than powerful enough. It's agile and can turn swiftly.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 大暴れイノシシ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 縞々が可愛いイノシシの子供。これが成長してあんな猛獣になるとは思えない。子供といえど、一撃離脱の突進は見事なもの。
entries.en: A wild boar cub with cute stripes. I don't think this thing will grow up and become such a ferocious beast. Even though he is a child the rush of a one-shot release is masterful.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: うりぼう
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 他の動物が食べないような物を餌とする方向で進化を続けた結果、最終的に暗黒物質を食すようになった。食べてもほとんど分解できないため体内は真っ黒。闇夜に集団で行進する。
entries.en: It continued to evolve in the direction of feeding on things that other animals would not and eventually came to eat dark matter. It is almost impossible to break down even if eaten so the body is black. They march in groups in the dark.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 闇喰コアラ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 優秀な魔法使いの家系に生まれ、才能にも恵まれた少女。エウダーナの実力主義教育もあってすっかり増長してしまった。箒乗りスタイルを流行らせようとしているが進捗はイマイチ。
entries.en: A girl born into a family of talented wizards she is also blessed with talent. This has been greatly enhanced by the meritocratic education in Eulderna. She's trying to popularize the broom riding style but she's not making much progress.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 空を翔ける『ネイン』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: かつて最強であったエウダーナの魔導士。現在は痴呆で魔法の大部分が使えない。だが今でも上級魔導士を凌駕する魔力を持っており、エウダーナ王も彼には敬意を払うとされる。
entries.en: He was once the strongest mage of Eulderna. He is currently unable to use most of his magic due to dementia. Even now however he still possesses magical powers that surpass those of advanced mages and it is said that the King of Eulderna respects him.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 老魔導士『ライゼル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 粗末にされた栗たちが恨みを晴らすため寄り集まって巨人に化けた姿。強固な肉体を持ち、火を浴びても熱ではじけたりはしない。仲間想いな性格で、栗をぶつけられると心が痛む。
entries.en: Chestnuts that were mistreated gather together to get rid of their resentment and transform themselves into giants. It has a strong body and does not burst from the heat even when exposed to fire. It has a companionate nature and its heart aches when it hits another chestnut.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 『栗巨人』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 本職は用心棒だが、それだけでは食っていけずに家庭教師も兼業している。特技はエビ反りと剣術。口調こそ丁寧だがリアクションが少々大げさ。
entries.en: He is a bouncer by profession but he can't make a living by himself so he also works as a tutor. His special skills are shrimp warping and swordsmanship. His tone is polite but his reaction is a little exaggerated.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 先生
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: トリュフと呼ばれる、きのこによく似たチョコレートに魂が宿った。食べられるために生み出されたことは認識しているが、その運命を素直に受け入れられずにいる。
entries.en: The soul is in a mushroom-like chocolate called a truffle which looks a lot like a mushroom. They are aware that they were created to be eaten but they are unable to accept their fate meekly.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: トリュフチョコの怪物
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 知識を司る中級神。かつて起きた神々の大戦、その一部始終を知る数少ない神族。元素の神とは祖父と孫のように親密であり、追放者は彼女がモデルだとされる。
entries.en: A mid-level god who presides over knowledge. There are few gods who know the whole story of the war between the gods. She is as intimate with the elemental god as grandfather and granddaughter and the exile is said to be modeled after her.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 《叡智のソピアー》
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エウダーナ国民の中でも飛びぬけて知識欲が高い。高位の魔法こそ使えないが、魔法を体系づけたのは魔法使いではなく学者である。
entries.en: He has an unparalleled thirst for knowledge among the people of Euldera. It is not the wizard who systematized magic but the scholar although higher-level magic is not available to them.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 異形の森出身。エーテルが蟲に与える影響の研究をしている学者であるが、狂暴な蟲と日々、文字通り格闘しているため戦闘力は高い。一児の母で最近は娘に嫌われまいと必死。
entries.en: A native of the strange forest. She is a scholar who is studying the effects of ether on bugs but her fighting power is high because she literally wrestles with violent bugs every day. A mother of one she is desperate not to be hated by her daughter these days.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蟲学者『マリア』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マリアに連れられて森を駆け回り、研究を手伝うのが日課。最近反抗的だが、内心ではマリアをとても慕っている。甘いものが大好きだがイモムシなども普通に食す。
entries.en: She runs around the forest with Mary to help her with her research. She has been rebellious lately but deep down she loves Mary very much. She loves sweets but she also usually eats caterpillars.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 巨大蟻の『アリス』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 富の女神に使い走りにされているうちに基本的な商売技術を身に着けた、賢いカラス。光り物だろうが惑わされずに価値を確かめるくらいの知能がある。
entries.en: A clever crow who learned basic business skills while being sent on an errand by the goddess of wealth. They are intelligent enough to see the value without being misled even if it is a shiny object.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アキンドカラス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 「ケサランパサランは幸運をもたらす」という迷信によって人間たちの欲望を一身に受け続けた結果、いつしか黒く汚れてしまった毛玉の妖怪。心もすっかり荒んでいる。
entries.en: As a result of the superstition that Kesalanpatharan brings good fortune they have been subjected to the desires of humans and as a result they have become blackened and stained. Its mind is in a state of total disarray.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ダーティパサラン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 毛玉の妖怪。風の強い日には飛ばされまいと必死な姿を見ることが出来る。視線媒体魔法を使うため襲われた際には相手を睨みつけるが、目が小さすぎて睨んでいるのか分からない。
entries.en: The hairball specter. On a windy day they can be seen desperately trying not to be blown away. They glare at their opponents when they are attacked because they use line-of-sight medium magic but their eyes are too small to tell if they are glaring.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ケサランパサラン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蟻のような巨大生物の親玉。ものすごい勢いで大量の酸を浴びせてくる。子供がいっぱいいすぎて全員の顔を識別することを諦めている。
entries.en: The parent of the ant-like giant creature. It sprays you with a lot of acid at a tremendous rate. There are too many kids and they have given up on identifying everyone's face.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ジャイアントクイーン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蟻のような巨大生物。地雷侍たちと交流を深めるうち、色々あってサムライ魂に目覚めた。役目を果たせないと悟るとおもむろに自害しようとする。奴隷狩りなどは行わない。
entries.en: Giant ant-like creatures. As a result of his interactions with the Jirai samurai he was awakened to his samurai spirit. When he realizes that he can't fulfill his role he boldly tries to kill himself. There will be no slave-hunting.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: サムライアント
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蟻のような巨大生物。暗い所では視認しづらい。エサとなる人間や動物を毎日せっせと運ぶ、働き者の女の子たち。甘いものに目が無いという可愛い一面も。
entries.en: Giant ant-like creatures. It is difficult to see in the dark. These hard-working girls work hard every day to bring in people and animals to feed themselves. She also has a cute side in that she has an eye for sweets.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ジャイアント
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エウダーナから奪った試作魔導アイテムと融合した兵士。10人に8人の割合で融合段階において適合できずにマナの流れがおかしくなって死ぬという。
entries.en: A soldier fused with a prototype magic item taken from Eulderna; 8 out of every 10 people die when their mana flow goes haywire due to failure to adapt during the fusion phase.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ジューア外法強化兵
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 冥界の力を操る蟹。死者の魂を食らうとされており、魂を食われると蘇生魔法でも蘇生できなくなるという風説がある。冥界ドラゴンとは共生関係にある。
entries.en: A crab that controls the power of the underworld. It is believed that the souls of the dead are eaten and it is said that if a person's soul is eaten he or she cannot be revived even by resurrection magic. It has a symbiotic relationship with the Underworld Dragon.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 冥界蟹
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 竜の呪いにより身体の半分以上が変容してしまっており、それを隠すため露出の低い服を選んでいる。竜族への憎しみは強く、狩場にされた竜窟からはドラゴンがいなくなったほど。
entries.en: More than half of her body has been transformed by the dragon's curse and she chooses low-exposure clothing to hide it. Her hatred of the dragon tribe is so strong that the dragon cave has been turned into a hunting ground.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 竜の狩人『スピファル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 女神の欠片を宿す魔物。下半身は蛇になっており、体温が低いとうまく動かない。そのため大気から熱を奪い取り活動するのだが、その副産物として冷気を生み出し攻撃に転用する。
entries.en: A demon possessing a piece of the goddess. His lower body is a snake and he can't move well when his body temperature is low. As a byproduct it creates cold air which it uses to attack.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: テルキネス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 女神の欠片を宿す半人半蛇の姿の魔物。予言と引き換えに生贄を求めるが、気に入った生贄は生かして下僕として傍に置いておく。
entries.en: A demon in the form of a half-human half-snake that possesses a piece of a goddess. In exchange for the prophecy it asks for a sacrifice but keeps the one it likes alive and by its side as a servant.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: デルピュネー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 集団で一撃離脱を繰り返す戦法を得意とする。1羽2羽では大して脅威にはならずチュンチュン鳴いてるだけで可愛いものだが、3羽以上揃うと牙をむく。
entries.en: With one or two birds they are not much of a threat and are cute just by chirping but when there are more than three of them they bear their fangs.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 首切雀
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 異星出身のスパゲッティのような怪物。人の頭の上に触手を乗せて休憩する習性がある。この怪物との出会いが、とあるパロディ宗教が生まれるヒントとなった…という説がある。
entries.en: With one or two birds they are not much of a threat and are cute just by chirping but when there are more than three of them they bear their fangs.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: スパゲッティの怪物
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 進化の過程で生まれた竜の亜種にしてワイバーンの最終形態。狙撃と連射を得意とし、瞬く閃光のように次々にターゲットを撃ち抜いていく。
entries.en: A spaghetti-like monster from a different universe. It has a habit of resting its tentacles on a person's head. There is a theory that this encounter with the monster was a catalyst for the birth of a parody religion…
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 閃光のワイバーン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: あらゆる障害物を突破しあらゆる場所に機器や兵員を送り込む目的で開発された。正式機とは違い次元歪曲ユニットは完全内蔵式。
entries.en: The final form of Wyvern as a subspecies of the dragon that was born in the process of evolution. They excel at sniping and firing shooting out targets one after another like a flash of light.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 超次元航行機『試作型メルガスト』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エルンという種類の妖精。姿を自在に消すことができ、神出鬼没。幾人もの冒険者が駆け出し時代に彼にガイドされているが、いつの間にか目にすることがなくなるという。
entries.en: It was developed for the purpose of breaking through every obstacle and sending equipment and troops to every location. Unlike the official model the dimensional distortion unit is completely built-in.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ガイドの『ノルン』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: きのこのような姿形をもつ悪魔。煩悩の化身であり、人々を惑わし堕落させようと画策する。興奮すると頭部から怪しいぬちゃぬちゃした液体を噴出する。
entries.en: A kind of fairy called Erun. He can disappear at will and is omnipresent. A number of adventurers have been guided by him in his fledgling days but he says that at some point he will cease to be seen.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マーラ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 重迫撃砲を搭載した車両。機動性と速射性に優れるうえにコストも低いため量産されている。迫撃砲ゆえに射程が短いのが短所。基本的に完全自動化されているが、一応搭乗スペースがある。
entries.en: A demon with a mushroom-like form. It is the incarnation of suffering and schemes to deceive and corrupt people. When aroused a suspiciously squishy liquid gushes from its head.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イェルス自走迫撃砲
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 元ロックスロアー。石を投げる側に回ったのはいいが、石をぶつけても平然としている者が多いことに逆切れし、グレネードに持ち替えた。
entries.en: The vehicle is equipped with a heavy mortar gun. It is mass-produced because of its superior mobility and rapid-fire capabilities and its low cost. A disadvantage of the mortar is that it has a short range. Basically it is fully automated but there is still space for passengers.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ボムスロアー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: １号機のデータを元に作られた量産タイプ。コストを抑えるために武装や装甲には汎用性のあるものを採用。いくつかのシステムもオミットされている。
entries.en: He was a former Rock Thrower. He went around to the stone throwing side which was fine but he snapped at the fact that so many of them were unfazed by the stones he was throwing at them and switched to grenades.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 量産型イェルスード
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 背中に外殻と一体化した蒸気タービンを持ち、そこから弾丸を高速射出する。一度絶滅しておりレム・イドの時代に復元されたが、無敵とされた丈夫な外殻は再現できなかった。
entries.en: It has a steam turbine on its back that is integrated with its outer shell from which it ejects bullets at high speed. Once extinct and restored in the time of the Rehmido it was unable to recreate the sturdy outer shell that was considered invincible.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ミスト・ドラゴン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エーテルを好む、偉大なる竜の上位種にして竜の暴君。その咆哮は周囲の魔物も狂暴化させる。しょっちゅう怒っているためエネルギーを消耗し、やせ細っている。
entries.en: Ether-loving high ranking species of great dragons and dragon tyrants. The roar also makes the surrounding demons go berserk. It is frequently angry draining its strength and making it emaciated.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: バーサーク・タイラントドラゴン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 寄り集まって針地獄を形成する、ハリねずみ型の魔獣。冥界に堕ちてきた罪人を針に突き刺して苦しめることで、罪を清算してやっている。群れからはぐれて地上に迷い込む個体もいる。
entries.en: A rodent-shaped beast that gathers together to form a hell of needles. The sinners who have fallen into the underworld are being tormented by sticking needles into them so that they can get rid of their sins. Some individuals are separated from the group and wander to the ground.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 針地獄ねずみ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 興奮すると針を展開し空気を吸って体を膨らませる。蓄えた魔力を針から矢のように発射することも可能。針が本当に千本なのか調べた学者がいたが案の定ミンチより酷いことになった。
entries.en: When it gets aroused it deploys its needles sucking in air and making its body swell. It is also possible to fire the stored magic power from a needle like an arrow. There was a scholar who looked into whether the needle was really a thousand needles and sure enough it turned out to be worse than being minced.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 針千本ねずみ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: まるで大槌のような巨大鋏を携えたロブスター。主に海底に生息しているのだが陸上での活動も可能。まずそうな色をしているが、火を通せば赤く美味しそうな色になる。
entries.en: A lobster carrying giant pincers that look like a sledgehammer. They live mainly on the ocean floor but can also be found on land. It has a ghastly color but if you cook it it turns a delicious red color.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: インディゴハンマー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 草原の主とまで言われる巨大なネズミ。耐性がないわけではないが寒さを嫌う。穏やかで人間になつく性質もあり、人里の温泉に浸かっていることがある。
entries.en: A giant rat that is said to be the master of the prairie. They are not intolerant but they do not like the cold. They also have a gentle human-friendly nature and are sometimes found soaking in hot springs in the countryside.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カピバラ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 変化能力を持つタヌキ。強力な魔物に化けて人間を驚かせたり、弱い魔物に化けて獲物を油断させたりする。ミミックとは互いに化かしあうライバル。
entries.en: A badger with the ability to change. They can turn into powerful demons to surprise humans or they can turn into weak demons to catch their prey off guard. They are rivals to Mimics who are also able to transform.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 化け狸
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 異常な素早さで彷徨する鐘の魔物。高速でまとわりつき、派手な色のボディで自分の存在をアピールしてくる。叩かれると大きな警戒音を出して辺りの魔物を呼び寄せる。
entries.en: A bell demon that wanders around with unusual speed. It clings to others at high speed and presents itself with a gaudy colored body. When it is hit it emits a loud alarm sound and attracts demons in the area.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 非情ベル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神々の最終戦争の際に、膨大な神力の余波を浴びて誕生した。辺り構わず触れるものは突き刺し、終末を呼び寄せ、最期には自爆するという、徹底した破滅主義者。
entries.en: They were born in the wake of an enormous amount of divine power during the final war of the gods. They stab anything they touch call for doomsday and blow themselves up in the end.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ラグナロック
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 暗い巣穴の中で暮らすうちに暗黒への耐性を身に着けた超獣。目が退化しており盲目状態にもならない。立ち塞がる壁は乗り越えずに掘り壊す派。
entries.en: A superbeast that has developed a resistance to darkness while living in a dark den. Their eyes have degenerated but they are not blinded. They prefer not to go over a wall that stands in their way but to dig through it.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 暗黒土竜
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 巨大なモグラ。ネフィア並に広大な巣を作り、実際に他のモンスターが住み着いていることも。身長がこの10倍、体重が1000倍あるギガモールという種類もいるが地表に出てくることはない。
entries.en: A giant mole. It has a nest as vast as Nefia's and is actually inhabited by other monsters. There's also a species called the gigamole which is 10 times the height and 1000 times the weight but it doesn't come to the surface.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: メガモール
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 迫害に伴う理不尽な暴力と戦うため、剣の腕を磨いたエレア。非好戦的な者が多い故郷の森では鬱陶しがられ、森の外では迫害され、結局ネフィア暮らしを余儀なくされた。
entries.en: Elea honed their sword skills in order to fight the unreasonable violence that accompanies persecution. They were harassed in their home forest where many of the anti-war protesters were and were persecuted outside the forest eventually being forced to live in Nefia.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エレアの魔剣士
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エレアの中でも特に賢い者たち。世間の迫害など気にも留めず、世界各地のネフィアを巡りその秘密を解き明かそうとしている。
entries.en: They are the wisest of the Elea. Not caring about the persecution of the world they travel to Nefia and seek to unravel its secrets.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エレアの大賢者
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神の欠片を宿す白い大蛇。その希少性と美しい姿から縁起のよいものとされ一部の地域では崇められているほどであるが、容赦なく攻撃をしてくる。
entries.en: A white serpent that harbors a piece of a god. Because of its rarity and beauty it is regarded as a good omen in some areas but it attacks ruthlessly.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ミシャグジ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: かつてテスカトリポカに敗れ堕天した軍神の末裔。その名は「黒いサソリ」という意味を持つ。大型で恐ろしい姿をしているが毒はない。チョコレートが好物。
entries.en: A descendant of a fallen war god who was defeated by Tezcatlipoca. Its name means black scorpion. They are large and fearsome but not poisonous. Chocolate is their favorite.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エク・チュアフ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: サウスティリスのメルカ地方原産の水陸両生生物。アホ可愛い外見からペット兼非常食として世界中に輸出されている。弱い毒の粘膜をもっており、素手で触るとピリピリする。
entries.en: An amphibian native to the Melkawn region of South Tyris. Because of their cute idiot appearance they are exported all over the world as pets and emergency food. It has a weak toxic mucous membrane that stings when touched with bare hands.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: メルカサラマンダー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 悪魔に売り渡された魂のなれの果て。何度も何度も死の苦痛を悪魔によって味わわされるのだが、それがいつしか快感に変わっていくのだという。
entries.en: The end of the soul that was sold to the devil. It is said that the pain of death is experienced by the demon over and over again but at some point it turns into a pleasure.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: デモンズソウル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 他のきのこ族に寄生して誕生する、おぞましい姿の子実体。分解者としての自覚がないのか、粘着質の胞子や菌糸で生き物を捕らえ直接栄養にしようとする。
entries.en: A horrible-looking child entity that is born as a parasite of another mushroom family. Lacking self-awareness as a decomposer they try to capture the creature with sticky spores and mycelium and feed on it directly.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヒポミケス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ロストテクノロジーで動く謎の人面岩。目から狂ったように発射されるレーザーは強力で、最大出力ならばインド象が2秒で蒸発する。
entries.en: A mysterious human-faced rock powered by lost technology. The laser fired like crazy from the eyes is so powerful that at maximum power an Indian elephant would vaporize in two seconds.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ブルーモアイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ロストテクノロジーで動く謎の人面岩。わざわざ岩をくりぬいて内部にレーザー砲が組み込まれており、いったいいつ誰がこんなものを作ったのかと不思議がられている。
entries.en: A mysterious human-faced rock powered by lost technology. A laser cannon is hollowed out of the rock and built into the interior and people are wondering when in the world such a thing was made.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: モアイ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ドラゴンへのコンプレックスをバネに努力を重ね、遂に上位のドラゴンより強くなった亜竜。しかし世間の「ドラゴンより低級」という認識は変わらず、絶望して全てを呪い恨むようになってしまった。
entries.en: Using its dragon complex as a springboard it has finally become stronger than the higher ranked dragons. However the world's perception of it as lower class than a dragon did not change and it cursed everything in despair.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カースドレイク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 死体の腐って衰えた筋肉では文字通りデッドウェイトにしかならないとの考えから、スカル化を施された。当然だが、その名の通り目が死んでいる。
entries.en: The idea that the rotting decaying muscles of a corpse would literally only make it a dead weight was given a skulling. Naturally as the name implies the eyes are dead.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: デッドアイズ・ブラッドスカルドラゴン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 復活の魔法を死亡時自動発動するように改良し、自分にかけておいたのだが失敗。こんな姿になってしまった。己の魔法技術に絶対の自信を持ち、ろくに実験もしなかったのが原因。
entries.en: It improved the resurrection spell to auto-activate on death and cast it on itself but it failed. This is what it's become. It had absolute confidence in its magical skills and didn't experiment much.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ネクロドール
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: サウスティリスでのギルド員の働きぶりを調査するために、魔術士ギルド本部から出向中。いつか支部を設立し支部長になるのが夢。
entries.en: She is on secondment from the headquarters of the Mage Guild to investigate the workings of the guild staff in South Tyris. Her dream is to start a chapter one day and become its president.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 魔術士ギルドの調査員『レーナス』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: サウスティリスでのギルド員の働きぶりを調査するために、盗賊ギルド本部から出向中。貧民街育ちであり、メルカーンのスラムにも難なく順応した。
entries.en: She is on secondment from the Thieves Guild headquarters to investigate the workings of the guild staff in South Tyris. She grew up in a favela and adapted to the slums of Melkawn without difficulty.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 盗賊ギルドの調査員『ナーガ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: サウスティリスでのギルド員の働きぶりを調査するために、戦士ギルド本部から出向中。ギルドマスターのフレイに憧れて加入したため、彼女に会えない現状を不満に思っている。
entries.en: She is on secondment from Warrior Guild Headquarters to investigate the workings of guild staff in South Tyris. She joined because of her admiration for Guildmaster Fray and is unhappy with the current situation of not being able to see her.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 戦士ギルドの調査員『ラタン』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ３対６枚の翼を持つ天使。天使族の中で最も上の階級に属する。６枚の翼で巧みに羽ばたくことでホバリングが可能だが、結構疲れるらしい。
entries.en: An angel with three pairs of wings totaling six wings. Belonging to the highest ranks of the Angel Tribe they can hover by flapping their six wings skillfully but it is said to be quite tiring.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: セラフ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 天使全体で見ると中の上あたりの階級に属する天使。その名は統治・支配を意味しているが、実際は中間管理職。今日も上司の無理難題と部下の世話で苦しんでいる。
entries.en: When viewed as a whole angels belong to the upper middle class. Its name means to rule and control but it is actually a middle management position. Today they are still suffering from the unreasonable demands of their bosses and the care of their subordinates.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ドミニオン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 割と下のほうの階級の天使。まだ未熟で、人間のように失敗もすれば成長もする。げっぷやオナラだってする。天使と言えど完璧で潔癖な存在ではないのだ。
entries.en: An angel of a rather low rank. They are still immature and like humans they fail and grow. They even burp and fart. Even angels are not perfect and fastidious.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アルケー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 元は罪人を葬るために迷宮に放たれていた狼だが、動物好きの罪人から餌をもらううちに人懐っこくなってしまった。罪人と協力して他の魔物と戦い続け、高い戦闘力を身に着けた。
entries.en: The wolf was originally released into the labyrinth to kill criminals but after receiving food from animal-loving criminals it became friendly. It continued to fight other demons in cooperation with the sinners and acquired a high fighting power.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ラストパーダンク
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 抜群の敏捷性とスピード、忍耐力を兼ね備えている。ブリーダーにすると機敏さを活かして散らばる羊の群を誘導し、牧場に集めてくる。
entries.en: It combines outstanding agility speed and patience. As a trainer they use their agility to guide the scattered flocks of sheep and bring them to the farm.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 牧羊犬
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 亡霊が宿り動き出した鎧。銀河の力に目覚めたそのパンチで発生するソリタリーウェーブは、１万ボルトのプラズマスパイラルを理論上無限遠にまで加速させる。
entries.en: The armor in which the ghosts dwelt and began to move. Awakening to the power of the galaxy the solitary wave generated by its punch accelerates a 10000-volt plasma spiral to the theoretical limit of infinity.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ギャラクティカファントム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アイテムに擬態した魔物。のこのこ近づいてきた注意不足な冒険者を、混沌の力を秘めた攻撃で襲う。何が起きているのかわからずに呆然とする冒険者を見るのが何より快感。
entries.en: A demon that mimics an item. It strikes inattentive adventurers with an attack that has the power of chaos. There's nothing more pleasurable than watching an adventurer stunned by what's going on.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カオスミミック
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 第一紀文明において奴隷として用いられていた粘性生物。反旗を翻して激戦の末に鎮圧されたものの、生存能力の高さから今日まで生き残っている個体も多い。
entries.en: A viscous creature that was used as a slave in the early First Age civilizations. Although they revolted and were subdued after a fierce battle many individuals have survived to this day due to their high survival ability.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ショゴス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 激しい怒りによって目覚めた半竜の戦士。その力は人を超え、竜を超え、神にすら迫る。近年、人と竜の混血化が進むにつれて覚醒例が増えてきている。
entries.en: A half-dragon warrior awakened by fury. Its power surpasses man and dragon even approaching gods. In recent years there have been an increasing number of cases of awakening as the hybridization of humans and dragons has increased.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 超竜人
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 全ての蜂の頂点に立つ、女王蜂ならぬ女神蜂。普通の蜂から信仰され、ゴッドロイヤルゼリーというなんだかすごそうな名前の物質を捧げられている。
entries.en: The goddess bee not the queen bee stands at the top of all bees. It's believed by ordinary bees to be devoted to a substance with the somewhat awesome name of Godroyal Jelly.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アー・ムケンカブ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: グランドマスターの中でも強大なもの。グランドマスターの数が増えたことにより、区別するために上位のものはこの名称でよばれる。
entries.en: The strongest of grandmasters. Due to the increase in the number of Grandmasters the higher ranked ones are called by this name in order to distinguish them.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ＜超グランドマスター＞
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: すさまじい食欲を持つ蜘蛛の怪物。光を食らい、闇を紡ぐ。あまりに飢えて自分の子孫を食い散らかしたところ、より強大な存在へと変異を遂げた。
entries.en: A spider monster with a terrifying appetite. It eats the light and spins darkness. It became so hungry that it devoured its own offspring and mutated into a more powerful being.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ウンゴリアント
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 戦いの女神の額から生み出された欠片を宿す。血と酒と殺戮が大好物で、特に血は流すのも流させるのも飲むのも好き。
entries.en: It harbors a piece produced from the head of the goddess of battle. They love blood booze and slaughter especially blood and they love to shed it and drink it.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カーリー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 神の片目。抉り出されて衰えていると言えどもその魔力はすさまじく、嵐を起こしたり海を焼き尽くしたりすることが出来るとされている。
entries.en: One eye of God. Even if it is gouged out and weakened its magic power is tremendous and it is said to be able to cause storms and burn the sea.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: バロールの魔眼
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 嵐と雷を操る神の欠片から生まれた大蛇。女好きで、興奮すると嵐を巻き起こし自分の身体を稲妻へと変化させて飛び回る。
entries.en: A great serpent born from a piece of the god who controls storms and thunder. It is a womanizer and when it is aroused it storms around transforming its own body into a lightning bolt.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: シュガール
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 恐るべき速さで瞬く間に接近し、斧を振りかざして襲ってくる。人を惨殺した後、溢れ出る血潮を用いて帽子を染め上げることを至上の喜びとする。
entries.en: They approach in the blink of an eye with frightening speed and attack with a swinging axe. After slaughtering a person they take great pleasure in using the overflowing blood to dye their hats.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クイックレッドコーム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 蝙蝠の悪神。大きな牙とナイフのような形をした鼻をしているが、最大の特徴は人の頭も一撃で切り落とせるほどの大きく鋭い爪。
entries.en: The Evil One of the Bats. It has large fangs and a sharp knife-shaped nose but its biggest feature is its claws which are so large and sharp that they can cut off a person's head with a single blow.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: カマソッツ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: かつて冥界を統治していた神の欠片を宿した魔物。その体はミイラ化しており、全身を包帯で覆っている。妹は大好きだが弟は大嫌い。
entries.en: A demon possessing a piece of the god that once ruled the underworld. Its body is mummified and its entire body is covered with bandages. He loves his sister but hates his brother.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: オシリス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 冥界において、疾病や老衰で死んだ者達や悪人を裁く役割を持つ。下半身が腐っているがそれ以上に性根が腐っており、気まぐれで地上に出て人々を虐殺することがある。
entries.en: In the underworld she is responsible for judging those who have died of disease or old age as well as the wicked. She has a rotten lower body but more than that she has a corrupt sexual drive and on a whim she can go to earth and slaughter people.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヘル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 黒い体の神鳥。戦場を飛び回り、戦士達に恐怖と狂乱をもたらして同士討ちをさせる。意外と家庭的で、血まみれになった武具を洗ってくれる。なお、武具を洗われるとその持ち主は近いうちに戦死してしまう。
entries.en: A black-bodied divine bird. They fly around the battlefield bringing fear and frenzy to the warriors and making them strike out at each other. Surprisingly homely it washes others' blood-soaked arsenal. If a weapon is washed its owner will be killed in battle in the near future.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: バズウ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エウダーナの中でも高位の魔法使い。生まれつき膨大な魔力を持っている者がほとんどで、下位の魔法使いからは尊敬と畏怖の眼差しを向けられる。
entries.en: He is a high-ranking wizard in Eulderna. Most of them were born with a huge amount of magical power and are looked upon with respect and awe by lower-level wizards.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 上級魔導士
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 決戦兵器の追加武装として開発された。接続して最大出力で発射した場合、余波でイルヴァの地殻が崩壊する危険性があると判明したため、やむなく砲台として単機運用されている。
entries.en: It was developed as an additional armament to the decisive weapon. When connected and fired at maximum power it was found that there was a danger of the crust of Irva collapsing in the aftermath so it was reluctantly operated as a stand-alone turret.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イェルス超重力砲
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 多数の素材を複合して作られ、強さとしなやかさを兼ね備えた合理的なゴーレム。だが、「単一の素材で作らないのは反則だ」という意見もあり学会で論争になっている。
entries.en: A rational golem made from a composite of many materials with both strength and flexibility. However there is an opinion that it is a foul play not to make it out of a single material and it has become a controversy at academic conferences.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: マルチプルゴーレム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 犬のような頭部を持つ小鬼の狂戦士。武器や鎧を捨て、知性の無い野獣のように激しく獲物へ襲い掛かる。
entries.en: A mad warrior imp with a dog-like head. They lay down their weapons and armor and pounce on their prey fiercely like unintelligent beasts.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ウルフヘズナル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 高い身体能力を誇る魔人の道化師。おどけた言動を繰り返しながら獲物を追い詰め弄ぶ。その様子に恐怖を覚える者も多い。
entries.en: A demon clown with high physical abilities. The prey is chased down and played with while the clown repeatedly says and does jokes. Many are horrified at the sight of it.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 魔人道化師
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 古代から人の命と魔力を奪い続けてきたリッチ。あまりに永い時を過ごしてきたため、本人にはもう生前の記憶がない。
entries.en: A lich that has been taking human life and magic since ancient times. He has no memory of his life anymore because he has spent so much time in this world.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エンシェントリッチ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 赤い翼を持つ半人半鳥の魔物。炎のように光り輝き熱を発する。火炎竜や朱雀の仲間と間違われることが多く、心底迷惑している。
entries.en: A half-human half-bird demon with red wings. It glows like a flame and emits heat. They are often mistaken for flaming dragons or Vermilion Sparrow companions which is deeply disturbing.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ガルーダ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 半人半鳥の魔物。機動力に優れ、上空からの奇襲を得意とする。鳥頭であることがコンプレックスで、ハーピーを羨ましがっている。
entries.en: Half-man half-bird demon. It has excellent maneuverability and excels at surprise attacks from above. They have a bird-headed complex and are envious of harpies.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鳥人の射手
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 術者本人の血液を始め、多数の魔族の血液を固形化して作られたゴーレム。戦闘中も、血液を棘のように変化させて相手に突き刺し血を奪う。
entries.en: A golem created by solidifying the blood of many demon races including the blood of the wizard himself. Even during combat the blood is transformed into a thorn and the blood is thrust into the opponent to steal their blood.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ブラッドゴーレム
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 威圧感のある眼差しを向け続ける魔物。歯向かってきた相手の視力を奪う、洗脳して土下座させる、などやることがエグい。
entries.en: A demon that continues to stare at you with an intimidating gaze. There are some ugly things to do such as taking away the eyesight of those who come at them brainwashing them and making them get down on their knees.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ビホルドゲイザー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 水陸両生の獣。かつてはその暴飲暴食ぶりから貪欲を象徴していたらしいが、今日では餌の不足により小型で少食の個体がほとんど。
entries.en: An amphibious beast. It used to symbolize gluttony but nowadays due to lack of food most of them are small and small eaters.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ベヒモス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: テスカトリポカに仕えるジャガーの戦士。身分の高いエリート貴族の中でも、選ばれた者だけが戦士団の一員となれる。
entries.en: A jaguar warrior in the service of Tezcatlipoca. Even among the elite nobles with high status only the chosen ones can become a member of the Warrior Corps.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: オセロメー
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 星の力を身体に宿した熊。体がオレンジ色に輝く。その名前は力の源である星に由来しており、「熊の守護者」という意味。
entries.en: A bear with the power of the stars in its body. The body glows orange. Its name is derived from the star which is the source of its power and it means guardian of the bear.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アルクトゥルス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 精霊の力を宿しており、昆虫の中でも上位の存在。他の虫を背中に背負う代わりに生命エネルギーを少し分けてもらう、という共生を行うため、乗馬に適性を持つ。
entries.en: It harbors the power of a demigod and is a superior being among insects. They have an aptitude for riding because of their symbiotic relationship in which they receive a small share of life energy in exchange for carrying other insects on their backs.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: オメガヘラクレス
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 世界の維持を行う神の欠片を宿した魔物。欠片として散る前の本来の神格は世界を３歩で踏破する、太陽光を操るなどの力を持っていた。
entries.en: A demon that possesses a piece of the god that maintains the world. The original deity before it was scattered as a fragment had the power to tread the world in three steps manipulate sunlight and so on.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ヴィシュヌ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 大家族で固まって暮らす習性のある動く岩。親の体内に子が隠れ住み、その体内に孫が隠れ住む。親岩が爆ぜたらみな爆ぜる。
entries.en: It is a moving rock that has the habit of sticking together as a large family. In the body of the parent the child lives in hiding and in that body the grandchild lives in hiding. When the parent rock blows up everyone blows up.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クラスター爆弾岩
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 狐の血の繋がらない義理の弟。「おとおと」という、さらなる謎の存在との関係性が研究されている。狐耳が邪魔でフードを被れない。
entries.en: The fox's non-blooded brother-in-law. He can' t wear the hood because his fox ears are in the way.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 弟狐
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エウダーナで品種改良されたグリフォン。周囲に霧や蜃気楼を生み出して操る力を持つほか、獲物を幻惑させる魔法を連射する。
entries.en: A gryphon bred in Eulderna. It has the power to create and manipulate fog and mirages around it and to fire a series of spells to disorient its prey.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ミラージュグリフォン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 黒い体を持つ狂暴なグリフォン。スピードとパワーを兼ね備えており、高速突進から繰り出される一撃は機械ですらたやすく引き裂く。
entries.en: A rabid gryffon with a black body. It has both speed and power and the blows delivered from the high-speed rush can easily tear even machines apart.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ブラックグリフォン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 鷲あるいは鷹の翼と上半身、そしてライオンの下半身をもつ幻獣。毛も生え変わりだいぶグリフォンらしい見た目になってきているが、まだまだ子供であり飛ぶのは下手。
entries.en: A fantastic beast with the wings and upper body of an eagle or hawk and the lower body of a lion. Their fur has grown up to look more like a gryffon but they are still young and not very good at flying.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 仔グリフォン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 魔族の血をひく客室添乗員。身体能力が高く、ハイジャック犯抹殺数トップの営業成績を収めている。元は荷馬車添乗員をしていたが、その戦闘能力から魔導船護衛として採用された。
entries.en: A flight attendant with the blood of a demon. She is physically capable and has the top sales record for the number of hijackers eliminated. Originally a wagon attendant she was hired as a wizard ship's escort because of her fighting ability.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: アテンダントの『エール』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 異常成長した巨大な人食い花。粘性液を分泌する蔓で獲物の動きを止めて捕食する。その名の通り巨人をエサにすることもある。
entries.en: A giant man-eating flower that has grown abnormally. They prey by stopping the movement of their prey with tendrils that secrete a viscous fluid. As its name implies it also feeds on giants.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 巨人食い花
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 武装がどうも体になじまない、と日ごろからぼやいていた。それを聞きつけた開発主任によって寝ている間に改造手術を施され、めでたく武装が体の一部となった。
entries.en: He had been complaining for some time that the armament did not fit his body well. After hearing about it the chief of development performed an alteration surgery while he was asleep and his armament became a part of his body.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: イェルスサイボーグ兵
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 邪悪な力を自らの身体に封じている。虫たちを統べる甲神にして暴君であり、時空を引き裂き雷を操る。その大あごで挟まれたら死を覚悟したほうがいい。
entries.en: They contain the evil forces in their own bodies. A tyrant in the form of a guardian god of insects able to tear time and space apart and manipulate lightning. Be prepared to die if caught between those mandibles.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: クワガタイラント
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 白銀に輝く神秘的なボディを持ち、古くから縁起の良い存在とされていた。気性はおおらかで基本的に無害だが、その体液は強力な酸である。
entries.en: It has a mysterious body that shines white and silver and has been regarded as a good omen since ancient times. Their temper is relaxed and basically harmless but their body fluids are powerful acids.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 白銀龍蟲
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 駒たちが心と力を合わせて融合した姿。制圧能力は低下したものの、その団結の力は戦術もへったくれもなく敵軍を単騎でなぎ倒す。
entries.en: The way the pieces fused together with their hearts and strength. Although its ability to control is reduced the power of its unity is neither tactical nor flawless it defeats the enemy army single-handedly.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ＜グランドマスター＞
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 複数のシェイドが融合した存在で、シェイドの集合体ということでシュイドと命名された。この魔物の影がさらにシェイド化することもあるため非常にややこしい。
entries.en: A being that is a fusion of multiple shades named shadow because it is a collection of shades. The shadow of this demon can become even more shades so it's very confusing.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: シュイド
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 精霊が鷲を象って実体化した存在。両翼を羽ばたかせることにより破壊光弾を放つ。高いところを飛ぶのに飽きて、たまに低空飛行している。
entries.en: A being whose spirit has materialized in the form of an eagle. Both wings can be flapped to emit destructive light bullets. It gets tired of flying high and occasionally fly low.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 孤高の荒鷲
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 急降下からの対地攻撃を得意とする巨大な鷲。間違えて自分より強い小動物に襲い掛かって返り討ちにあう個体も多く、絶滅危惧種である。
entries.en: A huge eagle that excels at attacking the ground from a steep drop. It is an endangered species because many individuals mistakenly attack small animals that are stronger than themselves only to killed.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: ストライクイーグル
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 右腕を覆う黒いガントレットを用い、接近戦を好む格闘家。より強いものを探し求めており、場合によっては自ら強者を育てることも厭わない。
entries.en: He uses a black gauntlet that covers his right arm and prefers to fight in close quarters. He is in search of something stronger and in some cases he is willing to raise a stronger person himself.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 黒腕の『レオルド』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 旧時代の害虫駆除用小型ロボット。このためだけに開発された超小型ジェットエンジンを内蔵。しかし価格の高さと互換性の低さで売り上げが伸びず、生産中止になった。
entries.en: A small robot for old-fashioned pest control. It is equipped with an ultra-compact jet engine developed just for this purpose. However due to the high price and low versatility sales did not increase and production was discontinued.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: プロジェットさん
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 害虫たちを統べる恐怖の魔王。毒電波とフェロモンにより半径14km以内のゴキブリを呼び寄せ使役することができる。あらゆる殺虫剤が効かない。
entries.en: A demon king of fear who controls the vermin. Toxic electromagnetic waves and pheromones can be used to summon cockroaches within a 14km radius. No insecticide will work.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 害虫王『サラシナ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 殺虫剤や放射線、エーテルなどをふんだんに浴びた結果、とんでもない変異を引き起こし戦闘力と免疫力と増殖力がアップした。好物は人肉。
entries.en: An abundance of insecticides radiation and ether resulted in an outrageous mutation that boosted their fighting power immunity and proliferation. Their favorite food is human flesh.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 殺人ゴキブリ
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 両親は演奏家で世界各地を転々としており、まったく構ってもらえていない。それもあり、頻繁に手紙やお菓子を送ってきてくれる祖父にとても懐いている。
entries.en: His parents are performers and have moved around the world and they don't care for him at all. For that reason he is very fond of his grandfather who frequently sends him letters and sweets.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 少年の『ウェル』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 年を経た蜥蜴が変異した。姿はドラゴンとよく似ているがどちらかというと神の方に近い。雷やそれに伴う轟音を操り敵を攻撃する。
entries.en: An aged lizard has mutated. Its appearance is similar to that of a dragon but it is closer to that of a god. It uses lightning and its accompanying roar to attack the enemy.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 青龍
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 父親の跡を継ぎ道場を譲り受けた。だがやる気が空回りした結果、門下生全員に逃げられてしまう。竹刀は父から貰ったもので、失くすと途端に弱気になる。
entries.en: She took over the dojo in her father's footsteps. However as a result of her lack of motivation she is abandoned by all her students. The bamboo sword was given to her by her father and when she loses it she immediately becomes weak.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 師範の『ナズナ』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 募集要項をよく読まずに応募してしまった。「雨を呼ぶために滅多打ちにされるマスコットの中の人」というバイト内容だったので後悔している。
entries.en: He applied for the job without reading the job description carefully. He regret it because his part-time job description was the person in the mascot who is often beaten up to call the rain.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 『着ぐるみのバイト』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 長い間、森とそこで暮らす生き物たちを守ってきた。寿命が尽きたその時、森の生き物たちの信仰心によって、白き炎に包まれ神への転生を果たした。
entries.en: For a long time he protected the forest and the creatures that live in it. At the end of his life he was reincarnated as a god enveloped in white fire by the faith of the creatures of the forest.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 白炎の『エストーク』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 遺伝子操作により生み出された人工生命体。エーテルの生成・散布器官をもち広範囲を浄化する。対メシェーラの切り札だったが量産される前にレム・イドは滅亡した。
entries.en: Genetically engineered artificial life forms. It has an ether generation and dispersal organ and can spread to a wide range of areas. It was a trump card against Meshera but Rehmido was destroyed before it could be mass-produced.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 『エーテルジェネレイター』
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。普段は皆シェルターで生活しており、庭園に出るのは月に一度ほど。
entries.en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. They all live in a shelter and only go out to the garden about once a month.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 旧人類
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威とエーテルの加護について次の世代に語り継ぐのが主な仕事。
entries.en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. His main job is to tell the next generation about the threat of Meshera and the blessings of the ether.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: レム・イド文明生き残りの子孫。メシェーラの脅威をよくわかっておらず、外の世界に憧れを抱いている。
entries.en: The surviving descendants of the Rehmido civilization. He is not familiar with the threats of Meshera and has a longing for the outside world.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 元は三匹のドラゴンだったが、元素のイツパロトルの加護を受け神化を果たした。火炎と氷という、相反する属性のブレスを融合させるだけの実力はない。
entries.en: He was originally three dragons but with the blessing of the elemental Itzparotl he became a deity. It does not have the ability to merge the conflicting attributes of fire and ice breaths.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: エレメントドラゴン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 全ての魔族の頂点に立つ王。退屈症のため暇つぶし感覚でイルヴァにやってきている。強い魔力を持ち、深い絆が無ければ王の洗脳を跳ね除けるのは困難である。
entries.en: The king who stands at the top of all the demon races. They come to Irva to pass the time due to boredom. Without strong magic and a deep bond it would be difficult to repel the king's brainwashing.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 魔王
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 下位の悪魔達を束ね治める領主。調子に乗った部下を一喝するのも仕事の一環。人の下につくのが嫌で全力で振り落としに掛かるらしい。
entries.en: A lord who unites and reigns over the lower demons. It's part of the job to cheer up a subordinate who's in a bad mood. They don't like to get under people so they try their best to shake them off.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: デモンズロード
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 堕落と原罪をこよなく愛する一般的な悪魔。他者を虐げることを好しとする彼らの戦闘能力は高い。肉弾戦でも魔法でも並の人間を上回るだろう。
entries.en: A general devil who loves depravity and original sin immensely. Their fighting ability is high as they prefer to bully others. They would outperform the average human both in physical combat and in magic.
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: デーモン
entries.label: label_2479

entries.jp: 深い洞窟内であろうと特殊電波により通信が可能。開発主任が直々に設計開発しておりやたら高性能。待機中は自動で戦闘行動を行い、データも収集する。
